descriptionFromApi:
Read this first

Most TA manager jobs are about keeping the machine running. This one is about building the machine. If you want a role where the process is already built and you just run it, this is not the one. If you want to build the operating system that brings the best engineering and GTM talent in the country to Hevo, and gives them the best hiring experience of their careers, keep reading.

Here is the honest picture. We hire strong people. The machine works. Now we get to make it exceptional.

That is the opportunity. Today a lot of what makes hiring work at Hevo runs on the strength of our people. The job is to build the system underneath them so the excellence compounds and scales with us. That means every candidate hears back faster than they expect. It means every brilliant person our CEO reaches out to on LinkedIn gets a clean, closed loop from the team. And it means the whole team pitches Hevo the way our best people already do.

Nobody has yet owned turning TA into a well oiled machine, and that is exactly what makes this one of the most exciting building jobs in the company right now.

What you will actually own

  1. 1. Closing the roles that matter, on time, every week. You own the outcome, not the activity. Priorities shift week to week, so every recruiter always knows their top three and is filling those funnels with candidates good enough to convert. When a loop stalls, you unblock it before the candidate cools off. The measure is simple: are the right roles closing, and closing fast.
  2. 2. Making our hiring process the best one a candidate runs all year. Great candidates are interviewing at four places, not one, and we win on respect as much as brand. A status update lands within a fixed window at every stage, nobody chases us, and every loop closes with a clear next step or an honest no, including the ones the CEO sources himself. You will see it in our offer accept rate.
  3. 3. Giving the business sharp, written visibility into hiring. We are good on a call and weak on paper. You fix that with one standard written update per function each week: pipeline, conversion, time to close, and roles at risk. Leaders read it async and know exactly where things stand. Numbers, not vibes.
  4. 4. Building a team that sells Hevo and runs a clean process. You inherit a talented team that has never had a real training path, and you build one: how to tell the Hevo story, screen with judgment, and run a tight loop end to end. The goal is to lift the whole floor, so selling Hevo is something everyone does well, not one person.
  5. 5. Turning all of this into a repeatable system. None of this is a one-time cleanup. You codify it, sourcing to offer, into SOPs on the Hevo hiring framework, and own the employer branding fundamentals: Glassdoor, our LinkedIn presence, and the collateral candidates actually see.

What the first year looks like

  1. Month 1 to 2: You know every open role, every recruiters strengths, and exactly where the funnel leaks. The candidate communication SLA is live and enforced. The CEOs LinkedIn candidates never fall through the cracks again.
  2. Month 3 to 6: The weekly written update is a habit stakeholders rely on. Time to close is trending down on priority roles. The teams training path is built and running.
  3. Month 6 to 12: TA runs like a system, not a scramble. The process is documented, the team sells Hevo with confidence, and our candidate experience is something people mention in interviews at other companies.

Who you are

  1. You have 8 to 11 years in recruiting, with at least 2 to 3 spent managing recruiters or owning a hiring vertical end to end.
  2. You have hired across both engineering and GTM. Not one or the other. SDE roles and AE, SDR, SE roles are both familiar territory.
  3. You have built or genuinely upgraded a hiring process before, not just executed someone elses playbook.
  4. You come from a place with a high hiring bar, ideally a high growth B2B SaaS or product company.
  5. You write clearly and you enjoy it. Given where the team is today, this one is non-negotiable.
  6. You know the India talent market and the tools we live in: LinkedIn, Instahyre, IIMJobs.

Who this is not for

  1. If you need a fully built process handed to you, you will find this messy. The mess is the opportunity, but you have to want it.
  2. If you avoid hard conversations with hiring managers or with your own team, the accountability part of this role will wear you down.
  3. If you would rather report progress on a call than write it down, we are not going to fit.

  • Data Platform Modernization: Implement the transition from SQL Server data warehouse to the next-generation Hadoop/Databricks platform, ensuring performance, reliability, and minimal business disruption. Develop hybrid data pipelines that bridge legacy and modern ecosystems, enabling near real-time data access for analytics and AI applications. Optimize existing SQL Server models (facts, dimensions, indexes, stored procedures) and design modern equivalents in Hadoop and Spark environments.   • Strong programming proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure (Glue, Synapse, Redshift, Delta Lake, S3).
  • Familiarity with Kafka, Airflow, Kubernetes, and containerized data services.

  • Strong ability to balance innovation and stability across coexisting legacy and modern data architectures.
  • Proven track record mentoring engineers and collaborating across global teams.

  • Execute with Excellence: Ensures reliability, performance, and operational maturity across all data systems.

jobDescription:
Job Title
AI Orchestration / Platform Engineer
Job Details
  • Number of positions: 1
  • Level: Senior / Lead Platform Individual Contributor
  • Primary locations: Hyderabad or Noida preferred; exceptional onshore candidates may be considered
  • Target / alternate titles: AI Platform Engineer; Agent Platform Engineer; LLMOps Engineer; GenAI Platform Engineer; AI DevOps Engineer; AI Site Reliability Engineer; ML Platform Engineer
  • Core keywords: agent orchestration, workflow engine, multi-agent systems, model gateway, model routing, LLMOps, platform engineering, Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, policy as code, observability, OpenTelemetry, queues, state, retries, resilience, cost telemetry, SRE
  • Recruiter red flags: Traditional DevOps profile with no AI runtime understanding; framework-only orchestration without production platform depth; manual deployments; no observability or incident ownership; cannot explain model routing, state, retries, evaluation, or AI-specific controls.
Job Summary
Role purpose: Build and operate the orchestration and runtime capabilities that allow agentic applications to move reliably from development into production. The role will integrate agent workflows with existing cloud, security, policy, CI/CD, and observability capabilities, supporting multi-step execution, model routing, state, resiliency, evaluation, and production operations without rebuilding the client's established platform foundations.
Client and delivery context: The client already has delivery pipelines, policy-based architecture, security controls, and production review processes. The engineer must integrate with and enhance those capabilities. The platform should support multiple models, clouds, frameworks, and developer-productivity ecosystems without forcing avoidable lock-in. The engineer will support shared patterns used across different business-process agents and may work across two parallel delivery tracks. Platform work must be pragmatic and outcome-driven, with emphasis on enabling engineers to release and operate reliable agents quickly.
Primary ownership: Agent workflow and runtime orchestration, including state, routing, queues, retries, timeouts, scheduling, persistence, and exception management. Model gateway and routing patterns, provider abstraction, policy-based selection, fallback, rate limits, quotas, and cost controls. CI/CD, environment promotion, configuration, secrets, infrastructure integration, release validation, rollback, and operational readiness. Application and platform observability, reliability engineering, incident response, capacity, performance, and production support.
Responsibilities
  • Design and implement orchestration patterns for multi-step agents, multi-agent collaboration, deterministic workflows, long-running tasks, approvals, and event-driven execution.
  • Implement durable state, checkpoints, queues, retries, backoff, idempotency, timeouts, compensation, dead-letter handling, and recovery for agent workflows.
  • Integrate model gateways and routing logic that select models based on capability, sensitivity, latency, cost, availability, or policy requirements.
  • Build deployment and release patterns for agent services, orchestration components, prompts, tool definitions, configurations, and evaluation assets.
  • Integrate with existing CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, secrets, identity, container, and cloud-runtime capabilities.
  • Create observability for agent traces, model calls, tool calls, workflow state, token usage, cost, latency, errors, quality signals, and dependency health.
  • Implement automated quality and security gates, including unit and integration tests, evaluation suites, policy checks, vulnerability scans, and rollback criteria.
  • Optimize runtime performance, concurrency, throughput, caching, context use, model selection, and infrastructure cost.
  • Support production incidents, root-cause analysis, capacity planning, resiliency testing, disaster recovery, and operational runbooks.
  • Develop reusable platform templates, SDKs, reference pipelines, dashboards, and onboarding guidance for agent-development teams.
Must-have candidate profile
  • 8+ years of platform, DevOps, SRE, cloud, distributed-systems, or software-engineering experience.
  • Production experience supporting AI/ML, LLM, agentic, workflow, or high-scale distributed application platforms.
  • Strong experience with containers, Kubernetes or equivalent runtimes, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration, secrets, and automated deployment.
  • Understanding of agent orchestration concepts including state, checkpoints, retries, timeouts, queues, long-running tasks, human approvals, and failure recovery.
  • Experience with logging, metrics, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry or equivalent observability, alerting, dashboards, and incident response.
  • Strong scripting or development skills in Python, Go, Java, TypeScript, or comparable languages.
  • Ability to integrate platform capabilities with security, identity, policy, data, network, and enterprise approval requirements.
  • Experience balancing reliability, delivery speed, latency, throughput, portability, and operating cost.
Preferred experience
  • Experience with model gateways, multi-model routing, provider abstraction, fallback, quotas, or AI cost controls.
  • Experience with LangGraph, Temporal, Airflow, Argo Workflows, Durable Functions, Step Functions, Kubernetes operators, or equivalent orchestration technologies.
  • Experience with AI tracing and evaluation platforms, prompt/model registries, feature flags, canary releases, and regression gates.
  • Experience with Terraform, Pulumi, Helm, GitOps, policy engines, service mesh, event streaming, and API gateways.
  • Experience operating platforms across AWS, Azure, GCP, hybrid, or private environments.
  • Experience in regulated enterprises or systems with sensitive proprietary data and formal production controls.
Indicative technology exposure
  • Kubernetes, Docker, serverless or managed container platforms; Terraform/Pulumi/Helm/GitOps; GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent; LangGraph, Temporal, Airflow, Argo, Step Functions, Durable Functions, or equivalent orchestration; model gateways and provider APIs; queues and events; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, cloud monitoring, AI tracing and evaluation tools. Exact products are flexible.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
We are currently seeking a MCP and Enterprise Integration Engineer to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
MCP and Enterprise Integration Engineer
Model Context Protocol | Enterprise tools and APIs | Secure, reusable integration
Position details
  • Number of positions: 1
  • Level: Senior Individual Contributor
  • Primary locations: Hyderabad or Noida preferred; exceptional onshore candidates may be considered
  • Target / alternate titles: MCP Engineer; AI Integration Engineer; GenAI Integration Engineer; Enterprise API Engineer - AI; Tooling Engineer - Agentic AI; Backend Integration Engineer
  • Core keywords: Model Context Protocol, MCP server, MCP tools, tool schemas, JSON Schema, APIs, microservices, enterprise integration, OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS, service accounts, identity, authorization, secrets, Java, Python, TypeScript, ServiceNow, SailPoint, CMDB, event integration, observability
  • Recruiter red flags: Only consumed MCP tools; no server implementation; generic middleware profile with no agent or LLM understanding; weak identity and authorization knowledge; no production API ownership; no contract testing or observability.
Role purpose
Design, build, secure, and operate MCP servers, tools, and enterprise-integration components that allow agents to interact safely with business systems, data platforms, knowledge sources, and operational services. The role will establish reusable tool contracts and integration patterns that can be extended by internal teams as new ecosystems and use cases are added.
Client and delivery context
The first MCP server and tools create the pattern for broader scale. Once the scaffolding is proven, internal teams should be able to add tools with lower effort and risk.
The client already applies strong review and security scrutiny to production MCP services. The engineer must produce implementation and evidence that can pass established controls.
Integrations may span service management, identity, configuration data, knowledge bases, data platforms, business applications, and custom internal APIs.
The engineer must understand both agent behavior and traditional enterprise integration; tool exposure must not bypass business rules, authorization, or auditability.
Primary ownership
  • MCP server architecture and implementation, tool and resource definitions, schemas, discovery, versioning, lifecycle management, and developer documentation.
  • Secure connectivity to enterprise systems, including authentication, authorization, secrets, service identities, network controls, and data access enforcement.
  • Reliable adapters, APIs, events, and integration services that expose controlled capabilities to agents.
  • Tool-level observability, testing, error management, performance, resilience, and reusable implementation patterns.
Key responsibilities
  • Design and implement MCP servers, tools, resources, prompts, schemas, and capability-discovery patterns aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Translate enterprise API and workflow capabilities into narrowly scoped, well-described, validated, and auditable agent tools.
  • Implement OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, service identities, delegated authorization, role or attribute-based access, secrets management, and least-privilege controls.
  • Build connectors and adapters for enterprise platforms, knowledge systems, databases, event streams, file repositories, and custom services.
  • Implement input validation, output normalization, idempotency, retries, timeouts, rate limits, circuit breakers, pagination, caching, and consistent error contracts.
  • Prevent unsafe tool use through explicit schemas, server-side business rules, authorization checks, confirmation patterns, and restricted action surfaces.
  • Create contract, integration, security, performance, and end-to-end tests for MCP tools and downstream dependencies.
  • Instrument tool calls with tracing, metrics, structured logs, audit events, latency, failure reasons, and dependency health.
  • Support deployment, release management, version compatibility, rollback, incident troubleshooting, and production support for MCP services.
  • Publish reusable SDKs, templates, tool-development guidance, examples, and onboarding documentation for internal teams.
Must-have candidate profile
  • 7+ years of backend, API, middleware, platform, or enterprise-integration engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience building MCP servers or equivalent agent tool and function-integration layers; direct MCP experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong development skills in Python, Java, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, or a comparable backend language.
  • Deep understanding of API design, JSON Schema, contracts, microservices, distributed systems, asynchronous integration, and error handling.
  • Strong identity and security experience, including OAuth2, OIDC, tokens, service accounts, mTLS, authorization, secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise applications, data systems, knowledge platforms, or operational tooling in production.
  • Experience with automated testing, API gateways, containers, CI/CD, logging, tracing, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of LLM tool calling, agent risks, prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and server-side control requirements.
Preferred experience
  • Experience integrating with platforms such as ServiceNow, SailPoint, CMDB systems, collaboration suites, document repositories, search platforms, or data catalogs.
  • Experience with API management, service mesh, event streaming, queues, webhooks, and enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience developing reusable SDKs, connector frameworks, internal developer platforms, or integration templates.
  • Experience with fine-grained authorization, policy engines, data entitlements, consent, or delegated user access.
  • Experience supporting multi-tenant, high-volume, or highly regulated integration services.
  • Experience with agent evaluation, trace analysis, and tool-use simulation.
Indicative technology exposure
MCP SDKs and specifications; Python, Java, TypeScript/Node.js, or Go; REST, gRPC, GraphQL, events and queues; JSON Schema/OpenAPI; OAuth2/OIDC/mTLS; API gateways; containers/Kubernetes/serverless; secrets and identity platforms; ServiceNow, SailPoint, CMDB, enterprise search, data platforms, or similar systems; OpenTelemetry and API monitoring. Equivalent technologies are acceptable.
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each clients needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form.

  • Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement permanent corrective and preventive actions.

  • Ensure adherence to SLA commitments with a strong focus on reducing recurring incidents.
Application Support
  • Support Software Delivery Lifecycle (SDLC) operations, including code compilation, builds, artifact management, and software distribution.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to CI/CD pipelines, repositories, and build systems.
  • Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps) and ensure build stability.
  • Validate releases to minimize production risks and rollback scenarios.
Infrastructure Automation
  • Provide infrastructure and platform support across Linux-based environments.
  • Automate repetitive operational tasks using Shell, Python/Java, or Perl scripting.
  • Support configuration management and automation tools such as Chef, Puppet, Ansible.
  • Improve system efficiency by developing automation solutions for provisioning, monitoring, and operational workflows.
Monitoring, Performance Reliability
  • Utilize tools like Splunk for log analysis, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Continuously focus on performance tuning, scalability, and system optimization.
  • Identify trends, defects, and system inefficiencies to drive proactive improvements.
Database Systems Expertise
  • Work with relational databases (Oracle, DB2, MS SQL, Sybase) and write optimized SQL queries.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Summary
The Senior DevOps Engineer is an advanced subject matter expert, responsible for consulting with internal clients about the software technology environment with high complexity.
This role translates business requirements into technology terms and develops more complex algorithms and programming code for software solutions.
The primary objective of the Senior DevOps Engineer is to design, test, implement and maintain software code that enables computer systems to perform specific tasks and assists with determining how technology can be applied to meet client needs.
Key responsibilities
  • Works closely with Platform Specialists to receive detailed business/user requirement specifications that identify the goals of the program.
  • Assists with the preparation of a technical requirements document, including systems and flowcharts that diagrammatically show how the information will flow through the computer and its peripheral or related equipment.
  • Analyzes business requirements and ensures that the designed solution meets those requirements
  • Transforms the detailed requirements into a complete, detailed systems design document that focuses on how to deliver the required functionality.
  • Performs proof of concept if required.
  • Compiles detailed technical specifications based on their designs for developers or IT Programmers to implement.
  • Converts a design into a complete information system. This includes acquiring and installing the systems environment, creating and testing databases, preparing test case procedures, preparing test files, coding, compiling, refining programs, and performing test readiness review and procurement activities.
  • Ensures that throughout the development phase, the process is documented including the development procedures for application use and security.
  • Examines any program errors in logic and data and makes the necessary recommendations to correct the program as required and/or escalate the problem accordingly.
  • Works with the required teams to assist with the installation and deployment of the application.
  • Assists with the resolution of any problems identified in the integration and test phases.
  • Supports all the code sets and implementations that have been implemented in production in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for the business.
  • Writes and distributes the task descriptions in a production environment to operate and maintains the solution that has been designed and implemented.
  • Assists with post-implementation process reviews.
  • Performs any other related task as required.
Requirements
  • Advanced knowledge on multi-technology application design best practices.
  • Ability to take holistic views of application environments, including hardware platforms, applications, databases, operating systems, and storage.
  • Ability to work with abstract concepts and have sound problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Advanced technical understanding of development and platform engineering.
  • Excellent client-centricity with the ability to focus on business outcomes.
  • Highly organized with excellent planning skills.
  • Advanced communication skills to effectively interact with a variety of stakeholders, including the technical teams and clients.
  • Ability to demonstrate impeccable attention to detail and work well within a team environment.
  • Excellent knowledge of project management principles to ensure that projects with clients are executed accordingly.
  • Ability to continuously contribute to the improvement of internal effectiveness by contributing to the improvement of current methodologies, processes, and tools.
  • Advanced knowledge to design, implement, and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate the software build, test, and deployment processes.
  • Advanced knowledge and experience with deployment and release management across environments.
  • Advanced knowledge of Automation tooling and source code repositories.
Academic qualifications and certifications
  • Bachelors degree or equivalent in Information Technology or related field.
  • Relevant DevOps certification preferred.
  • Relevant Agile related certification preferred.
  • Relevant certification of cloud platforms and services, for example (but not limited to) AWS, Azure, GCP.
  • Relevant certification of scripting and programming languages, for example (but not limited to) Bash, Python, Ruby.
Required experience
  • Advanced years of Software Development and Support experience.
  • Advanced years of experience deploying software solutions to clients in an outsourced or similar IT environment.
  • Advanced years of experience working in a multi-team environment across multiple geographies Programming/development experience including Agile processes such as SCRUM, KANBAN.
Workplace type
Remote

Job Summary

This role includes performing tasks such as security incident detection and response, security event reporting, threat hunting, content maintenance (tuning) and interacting with clients to ensure their understanding of the information generated, recommending client system changes as well as answering security related queries from the clients.
Key responsibilities
  • Works as part of a global Cyber Defense Centre (CDC) team that works 24/7 on rotational shifts.
  • Works with client stakeholders and relevant internal teams to tune the MSSP platform and client SIEM to enable more efficient detection, analysis and reporting.
  • Monitors security tools to review and analyze security logs from client environments.
  • Generates continuous improvement ideas for supported security tools/technologies, to enable improvements to the company services, employee experience and client experience.
  • Adheres to SOPs, customer Run Books and standard processes to ensure a globally consistent delivery whilst also proposing changes and improvements to these standards.
  • Utilizes and documents best practices and amends existing documentation as required.
  • Identifies opportunities to make automations which will help the clients and security delivery teams.
  • Performs security incident handling and response from several vectors including End Point Protection and Enterprise Detection and response tools, attack analysis, malware analysis, network forensics, computer forensics.
  • Utilizes a broad range of skills in LAN technologies, Windows and Linux O/Ss, and general security infrastructure.
  • Ensures usage of knowledge articles in incident diagnosis and resolution and assists with updating as and when required.
  • Performs defined tasks to inform and monitor service delivery against service level agreements and maintain records of relevant information.
  • Undertakes threat hunting activities across both individual client estates, as well as cross client hunting.
  • Manages unresolved incidents and follows up until incidents are resolved.
  • Works closely with client delivery teams to support their activities related to client delivery.
  • Cooperates closely with colleagues to share knowledge and build a cohesive and effective team environment, benefiting the individual, the business and the client.
  • Performs any other related task as required.
To thrive in this role, you need to have
  • Seasoned knowledge on implementation and monitoring of a company supported SIEM or security tools/technologies/concepts.

  • Seasoned knowledge and understanding of the operation of modern computer systems and networks and how they can be compromised.

  • Excellent spoken and written communication abilities.
  • Team player with the ability to work well with others and in group with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Ability to remain calm in pressurized situations.

  • Bachelor's degree or relevant qualification in Information Technology or Computing or a related field.

  • Should have more than 6+ years of experience in SOC.
  • Seasoned experience in SOC Analysis Operations.
  • Seasoned experience in SIEM usage for investigations.
  • Seasoned experience in Security technologies such as (but not limited to) Firewall, IPS, IDS, Proxy.
  • Seasoned experience in dealing with technical support to clients.
  • Seasoned experience in handling security incidents end to end.
  • Seasoned experience in configuring/managing security controls, such as SIEM, Firewall, IDS/IPS, EDR, NDR, UTM, Proxy, SOAR, Honeypots and other security tools.
  • Seasoned experience in Security Analysis or Engineering preferably gained within a global services organization

Hybrid Working

Job Description - SAP S/4HANA Technical Developer
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us.
We are currently seeking a SAP ABAP Developer to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
Location: Onsite / Remote / Hybrid based on project requirements
Employment Type: Contract / Full-Time
Travel: This position may require travel up to 80% based on project phase, deployment needs, design workshops, testing, cutover, and hypercare. Preferred location: East Coast or Midwest.
Role Overview
This role is aligned to a large global SAP S/4HANA transformation program delivered using SAP Activate, a Greenfield+ implementation approach, SAP S/4HANA RISE PCE, Fit-to-Standard principles, and a Clean Core delivery model. The role is expected to support formal design, build, test, deploy, cutover, hypercare, and knowledge transfer activities across a multi-wave enterprise implementation. The position requires strong documentation discipline, close collaboration with functional and technical workstreams, and the ability to operate within structured governance, change control, validation, and deliverable approval processes.
The SAP S/4HANA Technical Developer will design, develop, test, document, and support technical objects for a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role is responsible for delivering clean-core aligned technical solutions across RICEFW objects including reports, CDS views, enhancements, conversions, forms, labels, workflows, custom Fiori-enabling services, and approved technical extensions. The developer will work closely with functional teams, architects, integration developers, Fiori developers, BTP developers, data migration teams, security teams, and testing teams to convert approved business designs into scalable SAP technical solutions. The role must be able to evaluate when a requirement should be addressed through standard SAP functionality, configuration, Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, RAP-based services, BTP side-by-side extensibility, or formal RICEFW development.
Day to Day Job Duties
The selected resource will be expected to perform the following activities on a daily or weekly basis, depending on the project phase:
  • Analyze functional specifications, approved design decisions, and process requirements, then translate them into robust technical specifications and development objects aligned with SAP S/4HANA best practices.
  • Develop and support ABAP objects in SAP S/4HANA using modern ABAP syntax, CDS views, AMDP where applicable, OData services, Adobe Forms, enhancements, conversions, workflows, labels, and reporting objects.
  • Apply SAP S/4HANA Clean Core principles by avoiding core modifications and using released SAP APIs, released CDS views, approved enhancement options, Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, and side-by-side extension patterns where appropriate.
  • Design and build RAP-based backend services, behavior definitions, behavior implementations, validations, determinations, actions, service definitions, and service bindings to support transactional and analytical applications.
  • Support Key User Extensibility for custom fields, custom logic, UI adaptation, form adaptation, custom business objects, and lightweight process extensions when standard SAP tools are sufficient.
  • Support Developer Extensibility in SAP S/4HANA using upgrade-safe ABAP extension patterns, released objects, and lifecycle-governed development techniques.
  • Develop custom reports and CDS-based data models where standard S/4HANA, SAC, or delivered reporting capabilities do not fully meet approved business needs.
  • Develop and support Adobe Forms for finance, procurement, sales, logistics, HR, and compliance outputs, including invoices, purchase orders, credit/debit memos, dunning letters, payment advices, delivery notes, packing lists, export/customs documents, and HR letters.
  • Develop and support label-related technical objects for pallet, carton, item, traceability, vendor, packaging, and compliance labeling requirements, including integration with label management applications where applicable.
  • Support conversion and migration-related technical objects for master data and open transactional data, including finance, vendors, customers, materials, BOMs, routings, work centers, inventory balances, quality masters, employees, organizational structures, and open transactions.
  • Participate in RICEFW inventory refinement, complexity assessment, technical design reviews, code reviews, unit testing, defect triage, transport readiness, and deployment planning.
  • Support SIT, UAT, security testing, regression testing, performance testing, cutover rehearsals, production cutover, hypercare stabilization, and COE/support handover.
Basic Qualifications
The following skills and experience are required for this role:
  • SAP Technical Development: 8-12 years of overall SAP technical development experience, including 4-5 years of hands-on SAP S/4HANA implementation experience.
  • Implementation Experience: Experience in at least two full-cycle SAP implementation or transformation programs; Greenfield or Greenfield+ S/4HANA experience is strongly preferred.
  • ABAP on S/4HANA: Strong hands-on experience with modern ABAP, CDS views, OData, enhancements, forms, conversions, labels, workflows, and technical RICEFW objects.
  • RAP: Hands-on experience with RESTful ABAP Programming Model, including behavior definitions, service definitions, service bindings, validations, determinations, actions, and Fiori-ready services.
  • Key User Extensibility: Experience with custom fields, custom logic, custom business objects, UI adaptations, form adaptations, and lightweight extensibility options.
  • Developer Extensibility: Experience building upgrade-safe ABAP extensions using released APIs, released CDS views, approved enhancement points, and clean-core compliant development patterns.
  • Clean Core: Strong understanding of SAP Clean Core, in-app extensibility, side-by-side extensibility, and how to select the right extension option based on business need, complexity, lifecycle impact, and maintainability.
  • RICEFW Delivery: Strong experience designing, building, unit testing, documenting, and supporting reports, interfaces support objects, conversions, enhancements, forms, labels, workflows, CDS views, and custom technical objects.
  • Testing and Defect Management: Experience supporting SIT, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, cutover, and hypercare defect resolution.
  • Documentation: Strong ability to prepare technical specifications, unit test evidence, deployment notes, code documentation, and knowledge transfer material.
Common Project Delivery Expectations

The Security Remote Field Service Engineer (L1) is an entry level engineering role, operating in region and is responsible for providing a professional remote technical support service to clients by identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems.
Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role will restore service to clients by driving incidents to an effective resolution and ensuring all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions.
Responsibilities
  • Maintains the support process and ensures that requests for support are handled according to the procedures.
  • Uses service assurance software and tools to investigate and diagnose problems, collects performance statistics and creates reports, working with users, other staff and suppliers as appropriate.

  • Carries out agreed maintenance tasks.
  • Ensures usage of knowledge articles in incident diagnosis and resolution and assist with updating as and when required.

  • Escalates unresolved incidents and follows up until incident is resolved.
  • Provides service recovery, following resolution of incidents.
  • Documents and closes resolved incidents according to agreed procedures.
  • Maintains secure, accurate, complete, and current configuration on configuration items (CIs).
  • Applies tools, techniques and processes to track, log and correct information related to CIs, ensuring protection of assets and components from unauthorized change, diversion, and inappropriate use.
  • Remotely investigates and identifies root cause of incidents and assist with the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures.
  • Maintains knowledge of specific specialisms, provides detailed advice regarding their application.
  • Ensures efficient and comprehensive resolution of incidents, including ensuring that repairs are carried out by coordinating product requests, working with other team members.

  • Cooperates with all stakeholders including client IT environments, vendors, carriers and colleagues to expedite diagnosis of errors and problems and to identify a resolution.

  • Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.

  • Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.

  • Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
  • Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
  • Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
  • Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.
  • Entry level knowledge of vendor technologies, such as (but not limited to) Cisco, Microsoft, ARC, Audio Codes, PeterCOnnect , Sonus.
  • Entry level knowledge on management agent concepts, redundancy concepts and remote console architecture within supported technical domain.
Qualifications
  • Degree or relevant qualification in Information Technology or Computing or a related field.
  • Associate level Certification in different Security Technologies such as Cisco, Microsoft, ARC, Audio Codes, PeterCOnnect, Sonus such as CCNA, JNCIA, ACCA, PCNSA, CCSA etc.
Experience
  • Entry level experience in Security technologies such as Firewall, IPS, IDS, Proxy etc.
  • Entry level experience in technical support to clients.
  • Entry level experience in diagnosis and troubleshooting.
  • Entry level experience providing remote support in Security technologies.
  • Entry level experience in relevant technology.
Workplace Type
On-site Working

We are currently seeking a SAP BTP Developer to join our team in Hyderabad.
Job Details
  • Location: Onsite / Remote / Hybrid based on project requirements; Hyderabad
  • Employment Type: Contract / Full-Time
  • Travel: This position may require travel up to 80% based on project phase, deployment needs, design workshops, testing, cutover, and hypercare. Preferred location: East Coast or Midwest.
Role Overview
This role is aligned to a large global SAP S/4HANA transformation program delivered using SAP Activate, a Greenfield+ implementation approach, SAP S/4HANA RISE PCE, Fit-to-Standard principles, and a Clean Core delivery model. The role is expected to support formal design, build, test, deploy, cutover, hypercare, and knowledge transfer activities across a multi-wave enterprise implementation. The position requires strong documentation discipline, close collaboration with functional and technical workstreams, and the ability to operate within structured governance, change control, validation, and deliverable approval processes. The SAP BTP Developer will design, build, test, deploy, and support SAP Business Technology Platform-based applications, services, workflows, APIs, and extensions for a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role will focus on side-by-side extensibility and clean-core aligned solutions that complement SAP S/4HANA without modifying the core. The developer will collaborate with SAP S/4HANA technical developers, Fiori developers, integration developers, solution architects, functional teams, security teams, and testing teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reusable BTP solutions. The candidate must understand how SAP BTP fits into the broader extensibility strategy across Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, RAP-based services, and side-by-side extensions.
Responsibilities
  • Design and develop SAP BTP side-by-side extensions that support approved business process gaps while preserving clean-core architecture.
  • Collaborate with SAP S/4HANA technical teams and architects to determine whether requirements should be fulfilled using standard SAP functionality, Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, RAP-based service exposure, or SAP BTP side-by-side extensibility.
  • Develop BTP applications, services, APIs, workflows, and integration components using approved enterprise architecture patterns.
  • Consume SAP S/4HANA released APIs, CDS-based services, OData services, RAP services, and business events in BTP applications and extensions.
  • Support workflow orchestration for cross-system or exception-based approval processes where SAP Flexible Workflow is not sufficient.
  • Configure and support BTP connectivity, destinations, authentication, authorization, role collections, secure communication, and environment-specific deployment needs.
  • Work with Fiori/UI5 teams to integrate BTP applications with SAP Fiori Launchpad, role-based navigation, and user experience standards.
  • Work with Integration Suite developers to align APIs, integration flows, event-driven patterns, and connectivity to SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Prepare technical specifications, design documents, unit test evidence, deployment documents, support guides, and knowledge transfer material.
  • Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, cutover, go-live, hypercare, and handover to support/COE teams.
Requirements
  • SAP BTP Development: 6-10 years of overall SAP technical or cloud development experience, including 3-5 years of hands-on SAP BTP development experience.
  • Implementation Experience: Experience in at least one or two SAP S/4HANA implementation or transformation programs where SAP BTP was used for application development, workflow, APIs, integration, or extensibility.
  • BTP Services: Hands-on experience with SAP BTP application development, connectivity, destinations, authentication, authorization, role collections, and deployment concepts.
  • Extensibility Strategy: Strong understanding of Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, RAP-based service exposure, and BTP side-by-side extensibility.
  • Clean Core: Ability to design BTP extensions that preserve the SAP S/4HANA core and use released APIs, events, and services where applicable.
  • Workflow: Experience with SAP BTP Workflow or equivalent workflow/orchestration capabilities for cross-application business processes.
  • Integration: Understanding of REST, OData, APIs, event-driven patterns, SAP Integration Suite, and secure connectivity between SAP and non-SAP applications.
  • Fiori Integration: Experience integrating BTP applications with SAP Fiori Launchpad and role-based user access.
  • Testing and Deployment: Experience supporting unit testing, SIT, UAT, deployment, cutover, hypercare, and operational support transition.
  • Documentation: Strong ability to prepare technical specifications, deployment documentation, unit test results, and KT materials.
Professional Competencies
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive assigned deliverables from design through hypercare.
  • Ability to work in a global delivery model across onsite, offshore, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics to functional and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to work within formal governance, documentation, validation, change control, and deliverable acceptance processes.
  • Ability to prepare clear KT materials and support transition to application support or SAP Center of Excellence teams.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with SAP CAP, RAP awareness, SAP Build, SAP Work Zone, SAP Event Mesh, SAP HANA Cloud, or SAP API Management.
  • Experience in regulated environments requiring validation, traceability, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Exposure to GxP/CSV, GAMP 5, CSA, IQ/OQ/PQ, and requirements traceability.

Education

This senior individual contributor role requires deep technical expertise in designing and operating enterprise endpoint management platforms for NTT DATA's global clients. The engineer will drive complex migrations, lead technical workstreams, mentor junior engineers, and serve as an SME across SCCM, Intune, and co-management scenarios. This role is a key technical anchor for the India EPM team, supporting accounts across US, UK, Australia, and APAC geographies.

  • Design and implement SCCM/ConfigMgr hierarchy including site server topology, DP placement, and boundary configuration for enterprise global environments.
  • Architect Microsoft Intune tenant configuration including enrollment profiles, policy sets, compliance frameworks, and Conditional Access design.
  • Lead SCCM-to-Intune co-management configuration and workload transition planning for client migration engagements.
  • Design Windows Autopilot deployment profiles for Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) at scale.
  • Define EPM platform standards, configuration baselines, and governance frameworks for NTT DATA client accounts.
Advanced Patch Management
  • Architect and manage enterprise patch management programs using SCCM ADRs, Intune WUfB, and Expedite policies.

  • Develop and maintain patching runbooks, escalation procedures, and operational documentation.
OS Deployment Modern Provisioning
  • Lead enterprise Windows 10/11 migration and in-place upgrade projects end-to-end for global client accounts.
  • Design and manage complex OSD task sequences with MDT integration, driver management, and post-deployment automation.
  • Architect Windows Autopilot and Intune provisioning workflows for large-scale device refresh programs.
  • Define image standards, golden image build processes, and version management policies.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex OSD failures across diverse hardware platforms and global network conditions.
Automation Scripting
  • Develop advanced PowerShell automation for SCCM operations - collection queries, deployment automation, health monitoring, and reporting.
  • Build Intune Graph API integrations for bulk device operations, policy reporting, and automated compliance workflows.
  • Author and maintain WQL/SQL queries for SCCM inventory analysis, compliance dashboards, and operational reporting.
  • Develop reusable automation frameworks and contribute to the NTT DATA EPM India practice tooling library.
Leadership Governance
  • Serve as technical lead and L3 escalation point for complex endpoint incidents across assigned client accounts.
  • Mentor Grade 68 engineers, conduct technical knowledge transfer sessions, and contribute to team capability development.
  • Participate in client governance reviews, delivery calls, and technical steering discussions from India delivery centre.
  • Contribute to SOW definition, effort estimation, and technical proposal development for EPM engagements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and platform health improvement programs for managed accounts.

  • Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr - site hierarchy, OSD, patch management, applications, reporting (expert)
  • Microsoft Intune - full MDM/MAM lifecycle, compliance, Autopilot, WUfB, co-management (expert)
  • Windows 10/11 image management - task sequences, WinPE, MDT, driver management, Autopilot ZTP
  • Azure AD / Entra ID - conditional access, device trust, MFA, and identity-driven EPM
  • PowerShell advanced scripting - automation, Graph API integration, SCCM SDK operations
  • SQL Server and WQL - SCCM database queries, reporting, and compliance analytics
  • Vulnerability management integration - Qualys, Tenable, or equivalent
  • Strong English communication - client-facing delivery governance, documentation, and escalation management
Preferred Qualifications
  • Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) - required or equivalent enterprise experience
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate or Security-related certifications
  • Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Intune Advanced Analytics
  • Prior delivery experience supporting global enterprise accounts from India (10,000+ endpoints)
Minimum Education
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc. CS or IT) from a recognised Indian university. Relevant Microsoft certifications and equivalent senior-level enterprise experience will be considered.

Job Summary

Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Python, FastAPI, and MongoDB. The ideal candidate is strong in debugging, core backend problem solving, architecting scalable systems, and leveraging AI-driven approaches to enhance development and design workflows. You will play a key role in designing backend infrastructure, building robust APIs, improving system performance, and mentoring teams through technical challenges.

Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance backend services using Python and FastAPI.
  • Architect scalable, secure, and maintainable backend systems and microservices.
  • Develop RESTful APIs and ensure seamless integration with frontend and third-party services.

  • Contribute to infrastructure planning: cloud services, containerization, CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with DevOps to ensure smooth deployment and monitoring.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (product, design, QA).
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and architecture discussions.
Required Skills
  • 8+ years of backend engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and frameworks such as FastAPI (mandatory).
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB (mandatory).
  • Excellent debugging, code-analysis, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong understanding of backend design patterns, multithreading, concurrency, and API security.
  • Experience designing scalable infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), Docker, CI/CD (preferred).
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation and use-case diagrams.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to improve development efficiency.
Good to Have
  • Experience with microservices architecture.
  • Knowledge of asynchronous programming.
  • Exposure to distributed systems, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ).
  • Experience with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Python, FastAPI, and MongoDB. The ideal candidate is strong in debugging, core backend problem-solving, architecting scalable systems, and leveraging AI-driven approaches to enhance development and design workflows. You will play a key role in designing backend infrastructure, building robust APIs, improving system performance, and mentoring teams through technical challenges.

Responsibilities
  • Backend Development & Architecture Design, build, and maintain high-performance backend services using Python and FastAPI.
  • Architect scalable, secure, and maintainable backend systems and microservices.
  • Develop RESTful APIs and ensure seamless integration with frontend and third-party services.
  • Lead the design of end-to-end system architecture, including infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Database & Storage Work extensively with MongoDB including schema design, indexing, aggregation pipelines, and performance tuning.
  • Optimize queries and data models for scalable, high-throughput applications.
  • Debugging & Problem Solving Debug complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and deliver robust fixes.
  • Identify systemic issues and propose long-term solutions.
  • Create detailed use cases, troubleshoot technical debt, and improve existing codebases.
  • AI & Productivity Enhancement Leverage AI tools to accelerate development workflows (e.g., debugging, architecture suggestions, documentation).
  • Explore opportunities to integrate AI into backend systems and automation tasks.
  • Infra & DevOps Collaboration Contribute to infrastructure planning: cloud services, containerization, CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with DevOps to ensure smooth deployment and monitoring.
  • Collaboration & Leadership Work closely with cross-functional teams (product, design, QA).
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and architecture discussions.
Required Skills
  • 8+ years of backend engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and frameworks such as FastAPI (mandatory).
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB (mandatory).
  • Excellent debugging, code-analysis, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong understanding of backend design patterns, multithreading, concurrency, and API security.
  • Experience designing scalable infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), Docker, CI/CD (preferred).
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation and use-case diagrams.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to improve development efficiency.

  • Experience with image and dependency scanning.
  • Knowledge of secure software development practices.

title: District Coordinator - Rural Growth Hub
jobDescription:
Designation- District Coordinator - Rural Growth Hub
Programme- Strengthening Indias Agricultural Transformation- Rural Growth Hub Pilots
Reporting To- PMU Lead
Engagement Type- Fixed-term Employment
Locations (One Position for Each Location)- Bachhwara, Begusarai (Bihar) | Pallahara, Angul (Odisha) | Maregaon, Yavatmal (Maharashtra) | Indora, Kangra (Himachal Pradesh)

Vision for the Role
Athena Infonomics is supporting the NITI Aayog in the design and implementation of the Rural Growth Hub (RGH) programme- a three-year field engagement demonstrating how integrated, convergence-led agricultural transformation can be achieved at the village cluster level. The programme operates across five states - Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha, Maharashtra, and Himachal Pradesh- with one pilot district and one focus block per state.
The RGH is the operational centrepiece of this engagement. It brings together government schemes, frontier technologies, community institutions, and market linkages within a single village cluster as mutually reinforcing components of a coherent local development system. Rather than adding another layer to an already crowded programme landscape, the RGH works through what already exists: mapping farmers to schemes they are eligible for but not accessing, embedding technologies within existing government delivery channels, and strengthening the capacity of frontline officials to coordinate more effectively. The programme sits within a broader national architecture. PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (PM-DDKY) provide a reference framework for scheme convergence across 100 aspirational agricultural districts that RGH could learn from and inform. The upcoming Rural Prosperity and Resilience Programme (RPRP) is expected to provide a future financing pathway for scaling what the RGH pilots demonstrate.


The District Coordinator is Athenas single point of contact at the district and focus block level across all concerned departments. This is the role of the primary field intelligence anchor - someone sufficiently embedded in the district and block ecosystem to understand what is happening in practice, what are the opportunities for convergence and what needs to be enabled to make it happen, and how the RGH model can credibly strengthen farmer, village, and block-level outcomes. The District Coordinators ground-level judgement and documentation are the raw material from which the programme learns.


What You Will Own
  • Ground-level intelligence: a current, granular understanding of the agricultural and rural livelihoods landscape in your district and focus block - going beyond administrative data to understand what is happening in practice, how frontline officials are operating, and where scheme intent diverges from farmer experience, existing adoption level of technologies and the market for such services.
  • District and block action plan engagement: systematic gathering and analysis of the District Agriculture and Allied Activities Plan (DAAP) and block-level action plans wherever they exist, and contribution to the design of the Village Cluster Agriculture Action Plan (VCAAP) - the shared planning instrument anchoring the RGH cluster.
  • Intervention mapping, validation, and orchestration: a comprehensive, honest assessment of all active interventions in the focus block - government schemes, technology pilots, and civil society activities - evaluating what is working for which farmer profiles and documenting clearly where it is not. The role is primarily to inform the larger orchestration efforts towards matchmaking, prioritisations, additional activities to amplify impact by different stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder interface: Establish and manager primary working relationship with the District Collectors, District and Block Agriculture / Horticulture Officers, BDO, DPM-RL, Village Pradhans, Panchayat Secretaries, CRPs, KVK staff, and NRLM field functionaries - convening cluster coordination meetings and tracking scheme enrolment, delivery timelines, and institutional bottlenecks. The role also requires engagement with officials at the state level on areas where state level institutions, infrastructure and digital initiatives could be leveraged for scale up.
  • Technical and process documentation: weekly field observation logs, structured farmer feedback records, convergence opportunity matrices, technology adoption data, and monthly field intelligence reports - the mechanism through which ground-level learning becomes evidence that shapes programme adaptation and national policy.

Key Responsibilities

Scheme convergence and farmer-level mapping
  • Map every farmer in the RGH cluster to their current scheme enrolment status, eligibility gaps, and access barriers, building a convergence opportunity matrix per farmer profile and season. Build a strong and contextual understanding of focus schemes including underlying issues and challenges, areas for improvement etc.
  • Coordinate with block and district line department officers to unlock scheme access for eligible farmers, with particular attention to women farmers, SHG members, and marginal landholders. Track progress weekly against the programme target of a minimum of five schemes per farmer in the cluster.
Frontier technology assessment and deployment support
  • Assess existing frontier technology deployments in the focus block - drones, AI advisory systems, soil health tools, precision irrigation, digital crop surveys - evaluating adoption rates, farmer experience, and input efficiency outcomes.
  • Support identification and validation of additional technologies to be layered on existing interventions if any, ensuring they are embedded within government delivery systems and that data collection protocols meet programme standards.
Ground intelligence and field reporting
  • Maintain weekly field observation logs and prepare monthly field intelligence reports synthesising what is working, what is not, and what course corrections are needed.
  • Oversee conduction of structured farmer feedback sessions at the midline and endline, contributing to the programmes baseline-midline-endline survey framework and the generation of outcome data on farm income, yield, input costs, and market access.
  • Travel between the District Headquarters and Blocks as needed with a focus on project outputs and outcomes rather than activities.
Data systems and Shared Data Map maintenance
  • Maintain and update the Shared Data Map - the field-level data convergence instrument to ensure clarity on what data systems, parameters exist including information on data quality, validation status etc.
Community institution strengthening
  • Engage with SHG leads and KVK extension staff to assess the institutional capacity of community organisations around collective scheme enrolment, market linkage, and technology adoption and identify areas of support.

Additional Responsibilities

In addition to responsibilities under the Rural Growth Hub (RGH) Project, the selected candidate will be expected to support and contribute to other ongoing projects, assignments, and initiatives undertaken by Athena Infonomics in the state, as and when required. Such responsibilities may include project planning, stakeholder coordination, data collection and analysis, reporting, field implementation support, and any other tasks aligned with the candidates role, skills, and organizational priorities.

Who We Think You Are
You are likely to have between six and ten years of experience working at district /block / state level in agriculture, rural development, livelihoods, or related fields. You may have come through a social enterprise, an NGO, a government programme implementation role, a development consultancy, or a technology-for-development organisation. What matters most is whether you have spent substantive time at the district level collaborating with frontline officials, community institutions, and farmer households - and whether you understand how government actually works in the states where this programme operates.


You are genuinely curious about why things do not work. When a scheme is not reaching farmers, you want to understand the precise point at which it breaks down. You do not accept low awareness as a sufficient explanation. You have the patience to sit with a Block Agriculture Officer or a Panchayat Secretary and understand their actual operating constraints, not their official account of them. You write clearly - field reports that are honest about what did not work, specific about why, and clear about what it implies. You are at ease in a programme designed to learn and adapt rather than to deliver a fixed model.


WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO BRING
  • A postgraduate qualification in agriculture, rural development, public policy, economics, social work, or a related discipline is the minimum educational requirement.
  • Between six and ten years of work experience, with at least three years in a district or block-level role in agriculture, rural livelihoods, or a related programme.
  • Direct prior experience of working with state government departments - particularly those relevant to agriculture, rural development, and livelihoods - in the state of the district you are applying for. This is a requirement, not a preference.
  • Demonstrated experience of working across a multi-stakeholder ecosystem comprising government line departments, self-help groups, civil society organisations, and private sector service providers.
  • Working familiarity with at least one government scheme MIS or data system - e.g., the NRLM portal, PM-KISAN, PM KUSUM, PMKSY, PM-DDKY, PMFBY, AgriStack, or equivalent - at an operational level.
  • Strong written communication skills in English and in the native language of the district of posting.
  • Exposure to frontier technologies in agriculture is an advantage, though not a prerequisite.

What Athena Offers
The District Coordinator role sits at the most consequential part of Athenas work - the point at which research, policy, and technology meet the reality of a farmers field. The programme is a national engagement with NITI Aayog, supported by a leading philanthropic organisation, and designed to generate evidence that informs how India approaches agricultural transformation at scale. The field intelligence you produce will feed directly into the formulation and design of the RGH models across the focus blocks.

You will work closely with the central PMU team at NITI Aayog and Athena s Core Project Team, with regular structured feedback and cross-district learning cycles built into the programme design. Athena is investing in building its agriculture, climate, and livelihoods practice into a substantive national and international portfolio. For the right candidate, this role offers a genuine pathway into a growing organisation that values people who understand what is happening on the ground.

  • Competitive compensation benchmarked to development sector norms for district-level technical roles.
  • Travel support for district and block-level field visits and quarterly cross-district learning sessions.
  • Access to Athenas central research, data, and technology capabilities, including the APLYD AI and digital public infrastructure unit and the TolaData impact monitoring platform.
  • Structured mentorship from the central PMU team, with opportunities to growth within Athenas agriculture, climate, and livelihoods practice. [1]

Application Requirements
Please note that the selected candidates would be stationed at the identified block within the district with frequent travel to the District Headquarter.
  • Updated CV - not exceeding three pages.
  • A covering note (maximum four hundred words) on: which block you are applying for, your most relevant prior experience, and one observation from your field experience that you believe is underappreciated in how agricultural programmes are designed or how frontier technologies could witness accelerated adoption in the country.

Athena Infonomics is an Equal Opportunities Employer

Athena Infonomics is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.


This is not a guarantee or right bestowed upon the candidate but simply an opportunity to examine growth based on vacancy, performance during the period of engagement and mutual agreement.

jobDescription:
Title: Principal Outcome Manager
Level: Principal / Senior Director equivalent
Experience: 10-15 years
Location: Hyderabad, India (hybrid; some travel to US client sites)
Reports to: VP / Head of Delivery

About the Role
The Principal Outcome Manager owns business outcomes for our clients - not just projects. This is a senior consulting role that combines deep technology fluency, strong business judgment and disciplined delivery leadership.
It is not a traditional project manager role. The Outcome Manager agrees with the client up-front on what success looks like in measurable terms, leads the team that delivers it, tracks the outcome continuously, and stands behind the realized result.
In one line: agree the outcome, deliver the outcome, and make sure both the client and Tezo win.

Key Responsibilities
1. Discovery and outcome definition
  • Run discovery workshops with client business and technology leaders to uncover the real problem.
  • Translate the clients ambition into 2-4 measurable KPIs with clear baselines and targets.
  • Document and sign off the outcome, the measurement method and the review cadence with the client.
2. Shaping the engagement
  • Partner with sales and pricing to structure a fair, outcome-linked commercial that protects margin and gives the client real upside.
  • Identify risks early and decide - with leadership - whether to pursue, reshape or decline the deal.
  • Co-own the Statement of Work, ensuring every outcome term is unambiguous and measurable.
3. Execution and delivery
  • Build the right cross-functional pod (architects, engineering leads, data scientists, analysts) and set the operating cadence.
  • Drive day-to-day delivery through the leads. You do not write code, but you always know whether the work is on track to the outcome - and intervene early when it is not.
  • Manage scope, risks, dependencies and change with discipline.
4. Outcome tracking and realization
  • Stand up a simple outcome dashboard for each engagement: live KPI values against baseline and target, with leading indicators.
  • Run a weekly internal review and a regular client-facing outcome review. Convert lagging KPIs into corrective actions with owners and dates.
  • Close each engagement with a short outcome memo: what was committed, what was delivered, what the business impact was, what to repeat next time.
5. Stakeholder consulting and communication
  • Act as a trusted advisor to client business and technology sponsors - bring point of view, not just status updates.
  • Translate fluently between the CIO/CTO conversation (architecture, data, AI, technical risk) and the CXO conversation (revenue, cost, customer experience, time-to-market).
  • Manage escalations and disagreements directly; protect the relationship and the outcome at the same time.
  • Identify the next outcome and help grow the account.
6. People and team leadership
  • Lead the engagement pod with clarity on outcome and decision rights.
  • Coach engineering and consulting leads to think in outcomes rather than tasks.
  • Mentor junior consultants and outcome managers; help build the bench.
Experience :
  • 10-15 years total experience, with at least the last 5 years in a senior consulting, engagement leadership or delivery leadership role.
  • Proven track record of personally owning business outcomes - not just managing projects.
  • Strong hands-on engineering background (see Technical Background below). You should be able to ask the right second-order technical questions, even if you no longer build day-to-day.
  • Experience with US enterprise clients from an offshore-anchored base; comfort across India and US time zones.
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams of 15-40 people across geographies.
  • Exposure to non-TM commercial constructs (outcome-based, milestone-linked, gain-share, managed-service) is a strong plus.
Technical Background
This role requires a real engineering foundation. The Outcome Manager must be credible with client CTOs, enterprise architects and engineering leads, and must be able to challenge technical choices that put the business outcome at risk.
Programming and engineering (must have at least one)
  • Strong hands-on background in .NET (C#) (Microsoft Stack), React/Angular- at least 5 years building production systems, ideally as a lead developer or technical lead earlier in career.
  • Comfortable reviewing code, design documents and architecture artefacts critically.
  • Application, platform and product engineering
  • Experience across one or more of: enterprise application development, platform engineering (internal developer platforms, shared services), product engineering (SaaS / multi-tenant products).
  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices: API-first design, microservices, event-driven architectures, CI/CD, test automation, observability, DevSecOps.
Cloud (must have at least one)
  • Working knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform - including compute, storage, networking, identity, managed databases and the platforms primary AI/data services.
  • Solid Understanding of cloud-native development - containers (Docker / Kubernetes), serverless, managed services, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / CloudFormation / Bicep), 12-factor app principles.
  • Awareness of cloud cost, security and resilience trade-offs at enterprise scale.
Architecture
  • Hands-on solution architecture experience - able to shape the end-to-end design of a non-trivial system covering data, services, integration and front-end.
  • Working understanding of enterprise architecture - domain decomposition, integration patterns, reference architectures, ESB / API gateway, identity, master data, security and compliance.
  • Familiarity with one or more architecture frameworks (TOGAF, C4, Well-Architected Frameworks for AWS / Azure / GCP) is a plus.
Data and AI (good to have)
  • Working understanding of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse, BigQuery), data engineering pipelines, and analytics use cases.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML solution patterns - classical ML, GenAI, RAG, agents, MLOps - at a level credible to client data and AI leadership.
Behavioral Skills and Competencies
  • Business and consulting judgment - strong commercial instincts, hypothesis-driven thinking, comfort with trade-offs.
  • Stakeholder management - executive presence; credible with CXO audiences in writing, on a call and in a room.
  • Communication - clear writing, active listening, ability to translate between technical and business audiences.
  • Delivery discipline - uses KPIs and leading indicators, not status colors and percent-complete.
  • People leadership - coach teams, gives feedback directly and kindly, holds the line on quality.
Education
  • Bachelor s degree in engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline (required).
  • MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification (preferred, not required).
