Manager, Engineering

Company Profile:

NPS Prism is a market-leading, cloud-based SaaS business owned by Bain & Company. NPS Prism provides its customers with actionable insights and analysis that guide the creation of game-changing customer experiences. Based on rock-solid sampling, research, and analytic methodology, it lets customers see how they compare to their competitors on overall NPS , and on every step of the customer journey.

With NPS Prism you can see where you re strong, where you lag, and how customers feel about doing business with you and your competitors, in their own words. The result: Prioritize the customer interactions that matter most. NPS Prism customers use our customer experience benchmarks and insights to propel their growth and outpace the competition.

Launched in 2019, NPS Prism has rapidly grown to a team of over 200, serving dozens of clients around the world. NPS Prism is 100% owned by Bain & Company, one of the top management consulting firms in the world and a company consistently recognized as one of the world s best places to work. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a Manager, Engineering, to lead a team of engineers responsible for building the platforms and capabilities that support our product and analytics offerings. This role requires strong people leadership, structured execution, sound technical judgment, and experience working with modern data platforms with the versatility to guide engineers across multiple disciplines toward a shared set of outcomes.

The position will work closely with product, analytics, data science, engineering, and business stakeholders in a product-platform environment where reliability, quality, governance, and scalability are important to client and business outcomes.

The role is based in Gurugram, India, with a flexible working model requiring occasional office visits.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers, data scientists, and software engineers, supporting feedback, coaching, performance management, hiring, onboarding, and retention.

  • Build a team culture grounded in ownership, accountability, collaboration, technical curiosity, and continuous improvement across disciplines.

  • Own sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, capacity planning, and Agile practices to improve focus, predictability, delivery quality, and continuous improvement.

  • Coordinate team execution across product priorities, platform improvements, technical debt, operational support, and stakeholder commitments.

  • Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business and product priorities into clear plans, milestones, and team-level commitments.

  • Provide technical oversight across the teams systems and platform components, partnering with technical leads, architects, infrastructure, security, and platform teams to balance reliability, scalability, governance, compliance, cost, and production readiness.

  • Promote engineering best practices across disciplines and improve the reliability, quality, observability, and operational resilience of production systems.

  • Communicate plans, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Required Qualifications, Experience & Skills:

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelors or masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

Experience:

  • 8 years of experience in engineering or a related technical role, with strong depth in at least one of data engineering, data science, or software engineering, and the versatility to grow into managing across the others over time.

  • 2 years of direct people management experience, including managing engineers across different technical disciplines and developing high-performing talent.

  • Experience leading engineering teams that build platforms, products, or systems, with an openness to broadening scope over time.

Skills:

  • Solid understanding of software architecture, data modeling and integration, and production systems, along with exposure to cloud-based platforms such as Databricks, Azure, or similar.

  • Track record of leading Agile/Scrum delivery within an engineering team, including sprint planning, backlog management, estimation, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong planning, execution, and stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across engineering, product, and cross-functional business teams.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple disciplines.

  • Good understanding of security, privacy, compliance, and governance practices, with a continuous learning mindset and passion for Agile principles and engineering excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with AI technologies, AI-enabled data platforms, and their application in data engineering workflows.

  • Experience using Agile, engineering, or delivery metrics to identify bottlenecks and improve team effectiveness.

  • Experience applying security, privacy, compliance, or governance practices.

  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and the broader Atlassian toolset.

  • Prior experience managing a team with more than one distinct technical specialty (for example, a mix of data engineers, data scientists, and software engineers).

title: Change Management Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Change Management Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring strategic initiatives are successfully adopted across the organization. This role is responsible for developing and executing enterprise change strategies that drive stakeholder alignment, leadership engagement, organizational readiness, communications, capability building, and long-term adoption. Success in this role requires balancing people, process, and business priorities to help organizations realize the full value of transformation investments.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute end-to-end change strategies for enterprise transformation initiatives, ensuring successful adoption of new operating models, processes, technologies, and ways of working.
  • Integrate change management into program execution, aligning with business objectives, implementation roadmaps, and organizational priorities.
  • Assess organizational readiness by identifying adoption risks, stakeholder impacts, capability gaps, and resistance, and implement mitigation plans to ensure business readiness.
  • Consult govern enablement and adoption programs that equip employees to successfully transition to new ways of working.
  • Build stakeholder engagement and executive sponsorship strategies that drive alignment, commitment, and accountability across leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Coach leaders on effective change leadership, communication, and stakeholder engagement throughout the transformation lifecycle.
  • Lead meaningful conversations with business leaders on transformation program governance, decision-making, and negotiating resolution, using strong business judgment, situational awareness, and executive presence to read the room, steer discussions toward desired outcomes, and flag issues or red flags early.
  • Develop and deliver executive communications, leadership messaging, presentations, toolkits, and communication plans that clearly articulate the transformation vision, business rationale, progress, and expected outcomes.
  • Ensure consistent, transparent, and aligned messaging across stakeholder groups.
  • Define and monitor change KPIs, adoption metrics, organizational health indicators, stakeholder sentiment, and training effectiveness to measure success and recommend improvements.
  • Partner with strategy, program management, HRBP, Communications, learning and development, technology, business operations, and executive leadership to align change activities with business priorities and execution timelines.
  • Establish scalable change management frameworks, governance, templates, and best practices that strengthen organizational change capability and support continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 7-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management, Business Transformation, Strategy, Program Management, Organizational Development, Human Capital Consulting, or Business Operations within a global technology or SaaS organization.
  • Bachelor s degree in business, Organizational Psychology, Human Resources, Communications, Management, or a related field; MBA or Masters preferred.
  • Proven experience leading enterprise-wide change initiatives, including organizational readiness, stakeholder engagement, executive communications, adoption, learning, and capability-building programs.
  • Strong expertise in change management frameworks such as PROSCI, ADKAR, Kotter, or equivalent methodologies.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with Director, VP, and Executive-level stakeholders, with exceptional facilitation, executive communication, and influencing skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with experience measuring adoption, organizational health, and change effectiveness through defined KPIs and metrics.
  • Experience operating in highly matrixed, fast-paced organizations and collaborating across multiple business functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders in complex matrix environments, resolve conflict constructively, and bring strong business acumen and street-smart judgment to transformation governance discussions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and modern collaboration platforms; experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude to enhance communications, enablement, and change planning is highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PROSCI Change Management, PMP, Agile, Lean, or equivalent professional certification.
  • Experience in Management Consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, Accenture, EY, PwC, KPMG) or leading enterprise digital transformation, operating model redesign, organizational design, workforce transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.

Beyond the Resume

  • People-Centric Strategist: Drives successful transformation by balancing business objectives with organizational behaviour, culture, and employee experience.
  • Influential Leader: Builds trust, aligns diverse stakeholders, and drives adoption through collaboration rather than authority.
  • Executive Storyteller: Simplifies complex transformation into compelling narratives that inspire confidence and action.
  • Capability Builder: Creates scalable change frameworks, leadership capabilities, and organizational practices that sustain long-term transformation.
  • Data-Driven Change Leader: Uses adoption metrics, stakeholder insights, and organizational health indicators to measure success and continuously improve outcomes.
  • Thrives in Ambiguity: Brings structure, clarity, and confidence to fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Continuous Learner: Embraces emerging change methodologies, AI-enabled tools, and workforce transformation practices to continuously enhance organizational effectiveness.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Developer Platform organization is looking for a Software Engineering Manager to join our group in India. This organization develops and maintains the internal developer platform, security, compliance and audit reporting and all processes and controls that enable New Relic s fleet of engineers to effectively release our products to customers. Developer Platform teams work across all engineering teams to implement critical projects to support our business.

Our Engineering Managers are a select group of technology leaders and mentors who shape the solutions we bring to the market and foster an inclusive environment that brings out the best in people. If you have a strong technical background but you are also a person with great mentoring skills and that knows how to collaborate with multiple teams to ship great software, we would like to hear from you.

What you ll do

  • Treat the internal developer platform as a product. Define roadmaps, manage backlogs, and prioritize features based on internal engineer needs and business objectives.
  • Drive and contribute to our culture of operational and business efficiency: secure code, CI/CD pipelines, unit testing, regression testing, uptime, using smart telemetry data to make decisions, investment in technical and infrastructure debt, and blameless root-cause analysis with a learner and growth mindset.
  • Design and promote "golden paths" that standardize development, deployment, and testing, reducing friction by fostering self-service environments.
  • Attend operational review meetings and bring postmortem learnings back to the team and organization.
  • Learn from some of the brightest minds in the business-who are also looking to learn from you-while coaching and mentoring people.
  • Drive the recruitment, training, and development of top-tier talent in the region.
  • Regularly collaborate with PMs, technical leaders, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and execute cross-team initiatives.
  • Work in an agile environment with a DevOps approach, where teams build and maintain their own software, including participating in second-layer support rotations.

This role requires

  • 10+ years of professional work experience in software development.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, or equivalent education/experience in a relevant field.
  • Hands-on experience coding in programming languages such as Golang, Java, Javascript or Python.
  • Hands-on experience driving the software architecture and design of large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using service-oriented architecture, object-oriented design, and RESTful API endpoints.
  • 6+ years of people management experience.
  • 5+ years of experience with tools such as Jenkins, ArgoCD, Temporal, Terraform, and Kubernetes.
  • Solid background in application and system programming, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and Linux system administration.
  • Deep understanding of the security, reliability, performance, and cost-effectiveness of distributed systems on public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP).

jobDescription:
About Business:

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL): AGEL is part of the Adani Group s promise to provide a better, cleaner, and greener future for India. Driven by the Group s philosophy of Growth with Goodness , the Company develops, builds, owns, operates, and maintains utility- scale grid-connected solar, wind farm and energy storage (Hydro PSP and Battery) projects. The electricity generated is supplied to central and state government entities and government- backed corporations. On the back of long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with central and state government entities, AGEL has leveraged its capabilities and expanded its presence across 12 Indian states. With the integration of pump storage and battery storage projects with large solar & wind portfolio, AGEL shall be best placed amongst peers to supply round-the-clock green power to India s grid. The Company continuously adopts and deploys the latest technologies in its projects. With the target of 50 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, AGEL is driving India on its renewable energy journey.

Job Purpose: Lead - Integrated Management System (IMS) is responsible for the strategic development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the Integrated Management System. This role ensures that IMS effectively integrates various management standards and frameworks, such as quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety systems. The Lead will focus on ensuring comprehensive compliance with industry standards, optimizing system performance, and driving operational efficiency through regular audits, process improvements, and stakeholder engagement.

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Engineering or a related field

Master s degree in Business Administration (MBA) or relevant certification in Operations Excellence (preferred)

Work Experience:

8+ years of experience in managing integrated management systems

Certifications in IMS standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001)

IMS Framework Design and Integration:

Design and integrate a comprehensive Integrated Management System (IMS) that aligns with ISO standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and organizational objectives.

Ensure the IMS framework integrates quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management systems into a cohesive structure that enhances operational efficiency and regulatory compliance, leverage industry best practices and technological advancements to create a robust and scalable IMS.

System Architecture and Process Optimization:

Develop and refine the architecture of the IMS to support seamless integration across various management systems.

Focus on process optimization by implementing advanced methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Management (BPM), utilize process mapping and simulation tools to identify inefficiencies and enhance process performance, ensuring that the IMS supports continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Risk Management and Compliance Integration:

Integrate comprehensive risk management practices within the IMS to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks.

Implement advanced risk assessment tools and techniques, including probabilistic risk analysis and scenario planning, to ensure robust risk management, ensure that the IMS supports compliance with local, national, and international regulations by embedding compliance checks and controls within the system.

Performance Monitoring and Data Analytics:

Establish advanced performance monitoring mechanisms using data analytics and real-time dashboards.

Implement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of the IMS and its impact on organizational performance, utilize data analytics platforms and business intelligence tools to analyze performance trends, identify areas for improvement, and drive data-driven decision-making.

Audit and Assurance Processes:

Develop and manage rigorous internal and external audit processes to ensure the integrity and effectiveness of the IMS, implement automated audit management systems to streamline audit processes, track findings, and ensure timely corrective actions.

Coordinate with certification bodies and regulatory agencies to maintain compliance and certification status.

Technology Integration and System Upgrades:

Lead the integration of advanced technologies and digital solutions within the IMS to enhance system functionality and efficiency.

Explore and implement emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and blockchain to improve data accuracy, process automation, and system interoperability, plan and execute system upgrades to ensure the IMS remains current with technological advancements and industry standards.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Senior Leadership Team

Department SPOCs

Operations Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

External Auditors

Industry Certification Bodies

Regulatory Agencies

Consultants

The PMO - Value, AI Measurement plays a pivotal role in ensuring that transformation investments deliver tangible business value. This role establishes the measurement framework that connects strategy to execution, defines success metrics, tracks value realization, and equips executive leadership with the insights needed to make informed decisions. In addition, the role drives adoption of AI-enabled measurement and reporting capabilities to modernize portfolio governance and accelerate decision-making.

What you'll be doing

  • Deliver Executive Performance Reporting: Design executive dashboards and balanced scorecards that provide predictive insights into portfolio health, delivery performance, business value, adoption, financial, customer, workforce, and operational metrics.

Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills with the ability to drive meaningful conversations with business leaders, navigate competing priorities, read the room, lead discussions toward desired outcomes, and proactively surface issues or red flags early.
  • Build Scalable Measurement Capability: Develop repeatable measurement frameworks, governance processes, templates, and reporting standards that improve organizational maturity and support future strategic initiatives.
  • Drive Data-Informed Decisions: Translate complex portfolio data into actionable executive insights by identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and leading indicators, enabling proactive business decisions.

What we want from you

  • 8-12 years of experience in Strategy, Business Operations, Transformation, Portfolio Management, PMO, Business Analytics, Value Management, or Management Consulting within a global technology or SaaS organization.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Technology, or a related field; MBA or strategic transformation experience preferred
  • Proven experience leading enterprise-wide transformation or strategic initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated expertise in designing KPI frameworks, executive scorecards, OKRs, value realization models, and portfolio governance mechanisms.

jobDescription:
About Enterpret

At Enterpret, we are building the customer feedback intelligence platform that turns unstructured customer feedback into a structured, queryable source of truth - solving complex problems in natural language processing, serverless computing, and analytics on the frontend, pushing the envelope of whats possible by applying first principle thinking.

Kleiner Perkins and Sequoia Capital back us because they share our conviction that product development teams deserve a better way to understand their customers. That conviction is validated by the respected product teams who rely on us every day, including Canva, Notion, Samsung, and Loom.

We love working with folks who are resourceful, thrive in ambiguity, and display a strong sense of ownership.

Our engineering culture is built around leveraging and contributing to open-source tools. We aim to build upon and improve state-of-the-art systems in our field of work.

Read more about our team, core values, and operating principles - here .

What Youll Do
  • Design and deliver significant Graph Platform components end to end - high- and low-level design, implementation, rollout, and the follow-through after launch.
  • Improve reliability, latency, performance, and operational readiness across the knowledge graph, data systems such as DynamoDB and ClickHouse, Model Repository, LLM self-hosting platform, and the high-throughput pipelines that run our models.
  • Take production issues beyond the immediate symptom - turn recurring failures into durable fixes, not patches.
  • Build with metrics, alerts, runbooks, tests, and rollback plans as a core part of the work, so every change is safe and observable in production.
  • Own on-call and production responsibility for your area, and establish the operational baseline: failure modes, alerts, runbooks, and the gaps that need closing.
  • Partner with product engineers, product managers, SRE, and adjacent teams where your component has dependencies - and work closely with the people shaping the longer-term platform direction.
  • Continuously raise the engineering-quality bar through code review, testing, documentation, and support for more junior engineers.
What It Takes
  • 6+ years in software engineering, with evidence you can own a meaningful production component from conception to deployment.
  • 3+ years at one organization where youve designed, built, deployed, and operated a significant backend, data, or infrastructure component - not just shipped code, but kept it running well.
  • Comfort working through moderate ambiguity: you clarify unclear requirements, decide what needs to be built now, make design trade-offs across components, and deliver without constant direction.
  • Strong engineering-quality and operational habits: comprehensive tests, edge-case thinking, metrics, alerts, runbooks, rollback plans, and real production debugging experience.
  • Hands-on experience with high-throughput data systems or asynchronous pipelines - exposure to at least one of DynamoDB, ClickHouse, Snowflake, or model hosting/inferencing is valuable, and prior experience with Golang, Python, or another object-oriented programming language is preferred, though direct experience with our exact stack is not required.
  • An AI-native working style: you use AI tools to move much faster while validating outputs, preserving quality, and sharing useful workflows with the team.
  • A track record of mentoring and collaborating - you raise the standard of the engineers and systems around you.
What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

  • Builds working context on the Graph Platform stack and takes on-call and production ownership seriously.
  • Owns a scoped production problem or component improvement from design through deployment.
  • Establishes the operational baseline for their area: relevant metrics, failure modes, alerts, runbooks, and gaps.
  • Produces designs that make the trade-offs explicit and can be implemented without significant rework.

By 6 months

  • Independently delivers a significant team-level component or feature from conception to deployment.
  • Has made a visible improvement to a Graph Platform outcome: reliability, latency, throughput, correctness, cost, or operational load.
  • Is a reliable owner in production: issues are investigated systematically, and follow-up fixes are durable rather than patches.
  • Raises the engineering-quality bar through code review, testing, documentation, and support for more junior engineers.

By 12 months

  • Is the go-to owner for a meaningful Graph Platform area.
  • Has delivered and operated multiple improvements that make the teams systems more robust, scalable, and maintainable.
  • Can take partially ambiguous requirements, clarify what matters, make team-level trade-offs, and lead delivery with limited oversight.
  • Has created clear runway toward L5 through broader component ownership and influence on adjacent work.
Why Enterpret
  • High Impact: Own systems that are already in production and need to scale well - the core data systems, models, and pipelines where Enterprets platform comes together.
  • Ownership: End-to-end responsibility for features and systems.
  • Complex Challenges: Work on the knowledge graph, distributed data tiers, model hosting, and high-throughput enrichment pipelines where a single change can touch storage, query paths, reliability, and cost.
  • Growth: Learn and grow with a high-caliber team, with a clear path from owning components to shaping larger slices of Graph Platform and into L5.
  • Culture: Open, collaborative, and values-driven environment with autonomy.
  • Benefits: Competitive salary, equity, hybrid work setup, premium healthcare, and more.
What We Value

At Enterpret, we operate with a deep sense of ownership - we play for the team and do what it takes to win together. We care personally for our teammates while pushing each other with honest, actionable feedback. Above all, we approach everything with humility and a drive to keep learning and getting better.

Equal Opportunities

We are an equal opportunity employer. We ensure that none of our employees or prospective employees receives less favourable treatment as a result of age, sex, disability, marital status, colour, race, religion or ethnic origin. Equally we aim to ensure that no such employee is disadvantaged by terms and conditions of employment which cannot be justified.

title: Solution Architect - Shared Data Migration
jobDescription:
Job Summary

You are the Shared Data discipline Solution Architect responsible for defining and governing the end-to-end approach to migrating SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and Teams-connected file content during a global tenant-to-tenant M365 consolidation.

This role exists because shared data migrations fail when they re treated like a tool run . You will define the information architecture-aware migration blueprint: permissions fidelity, sharing behaviour, metadata, large content, throttling, delta strategy, validation, exception handling and stabilisation. You will ensure the factory can execute with repeatable patterns using third-party tooling (e.g., ShareGate or equivalent) and that wave migrations don t collapse into rework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define target-state information architecture and governance considerations relevant to tenant consolidation (sharing posture, permissions model, external sharing constraints, retention sensitivity, content ownership patterns).
  • Define the tenant-to-tenant ODSP migration strategy including discovery, mapping, staging, delta moves, cutover approach and post-move validation.
  • Standardise tooling approach (e.g., ShareGate / Quest / equivalent): configuration baselines, scheduling patterns, throttling management, reporting outputs and error handling.
  • Define runbooks for key migration tasks: site migrations, OneDrive migrations, Teams files migrations, permissions reconciliation, link/sharing remediation, metadata validation.
  • Set and enforce quality gates: ready to migrate , ready to cutover , accepted criteria including evidence packs and sampling methodologies.
  • Create the exception framework for difficult content (very large libraries, broken inheritance sprawl, customisations, third-party integrations, legacy workflows, blocked file types).
  • Define a repeatable approach to permissions and sharing parity (what is equivalent , what must be remediated, what requires business sign-off).
  • Lead escalation on complex failures: permissions anomalies, throttling, content mismatches, orphaned identities, broken sharing links, Teams dependency problems.
  • Produce operational metrics for factory execution: throughput, failure categories, rework rate, top blockers and continuous improvement backlog.
  • Align Shared Data cutovers to Identity/Devices/Teams readiness so user experience is protected.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Proven delivery of tenant-to-tenant SharePoint/OneDrive migrations at enterprise scale which must be evidenced.
  • Deep SharePoint Online/OneDrive expertise (permissions, sharing, IA, metadata, site templates, modern site constructs, governance controls).
  • Hands-on experience using ShareGate (preferred) or comparable enterprise migration tooling and ability to interpret logs and failure modes.
  • Strong understanding of Teams-connected content storage patterns and how Teams usage intersects with SharePoint/OneDrive.
  • Experience building factory-ready runbooks, validation gates and evidence packs to drive repeatable execution.
  • Strong troubleshooting mindset: can isolate issues quickly, define a fix pattern and push it into standard practice.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience with highly regulated or complex governance environments (strict retention, compliance, sensitivity labelling interactions).
  • Familiarity with scripting and automation for checks/remediation (PowerShell/Graph).
  • Knowledge of common ODSP migration pitfalls: link behaviour, sharing model differences, permissions sprawl, performance constraints, change windows.

Interpersonal Consulting Skills

  • Can drive standards adoption across multiple teams and regions without becoming a blocker.
  • Clear communicator of data risk and end-user impact; no false confidence.
  • Bases trust with business content owners through clarity, not jargon.
  • Maintains a high-quality bar and reduces rework through proper readiness control.
  • Coaches the factory SMEs; enables scaled delivery rather than acting as a bottleneck.

Shift / Working Pattern

This role operates within a three-shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

jobDescription:
We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Principal Artificial Intelligence (AI) Solutions Architect to define, build, and govern Sensata s enterprise AI technical foundation. This role is expected to combine enterprise architecture judgment with practical implementation ability; the person must be comfortable moving between strategy, design, prototyping, vendor challenge, and production-readiness review

This is not a purely strategic or oversight role. You will be expected to actively design, prototype, and guide implementation of production AI systems in complex enterprise environments. This role will operate under the direction of the Artificial Intelligence Leader (Head of AI) and will support enterprise AI priorities across functions, including but not limited to engineering, procurement, supply chain, operations, legal, quality, and commercial teams

You will establish the AI reference architecture that ensures scalable, reusable, and integrated solutions across the business-while also staying close to execution, validating designs through real implementations. Ideally you have personally deployed production AI systems, understands modern GenAI architectures (LLMs, RAG, agents), and are comfortable working directly with code, data, and enterprise systems.

This role is critical in preventing fragmented, vendor-driven solutions and ensuring AI is built once and scaled effectively across use cases.

General Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the AI architecture roadmap, including platforms, tools, frameworks, integration patterns, and reusable design standards.
  • Translate complex business needs into scalable AI solution architectures that align with enterprise technology, data, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Design end-to-end AI systems, including data pipelines, model development workflows, model deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish architectural guardrails for generative AI, machine learning, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent agents, APIs, and model integration patterns.
  • Partner with engineering, data science, product, security, legal, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are reliable, responsible, and fit for purpose.
  • Guide teams in implementing, testing, governance, and cost optimization practices for production AI systems.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, vendors, and frameworks and recommend adoption strategies that balance innovation, risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and architectural review for teams building AI-enabled products, platforms, and internal capabilities.
  • Drive consistency and reuse by creating reference architectures, implementation playbooks, design patterns, and technical documentation.
  • Communicate AI architecture strategy, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities to senior technology and business leaders.

Experience / Qualifications

  • A university degree required (i.e. Bachelors degree) or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Must be a team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
  • Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
  • Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
  • Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
  • Holds self-accountable to achieving goals and standards
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
  • Strong interpersonal & collaboration skills to work effectively with all levels of the organization including suppliers and/or external customers

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Prototype and deliver hands-on AI solutions, integrating with enterprise systems (ERP, MES, PLM, APIs)
  • Build advanced AI capabilities (RAG, LLM workflows/agents, document intelligence, enterprise search)
  • Establish AI-specific data architecture standards (semantic models, metadata, taxonomy, lineage, access)
  • Implement production-readiness practices (evaluation datasets, hallucination testing, human-in-loop, observability)
  • Lead technical vendor validation and build vs. buy analysis through prototyping and benchmarking
  • Create reusable accelerators (modular components, decision records, implementation assets)
  • Prioritize AI use cases based on business value, scalability, risk, and speed
  • Execute effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with close alignment to delivery

Additional Qualifications:

  • 8+ years delivering production AI/ML solutions with hands-on engineering experience
  • Expertise in LLMs, RAG, vector databases, and agent-based systems
  • Experience with AI frameworks/tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI/Azure OpenAI)
  • Strong background in enterprise AI integration and data ecosystems
  • Proven ability to lead vendor evaluation and build vs. buy decisions
  • Preferred: Experience with Microsoft/Azure AI stack (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Fabric, Power Platform)
  • Demonstrated professional proficiency in English language, both verbal and written

title: Data Architect
jobDescription:
Position Summary
The Staff Data Architect is a hands-on technical role responsible for designing and personally building the data architecture patterns that power HCAs GCP-based Lakehouse and multi-modal ingestion platforms. Unlike a purely advisory architecture role, this position is expected to spend a substantial portion of its time in code authoring reference implementations, prototyping ingestion frameworks, writing production-grade pipelines, and proving out patterns before they are adopted at scale.
This role owns architecture for a defined platform or data domain rather than the enterprise as a whole, and operates as the senior technical authority within that scope. The Staff Data Architect translates business and clinical requirements into durable designs, then demonstrates those designs in working code that engineering teams extend. Design decisions are earned through implementation: if a pattern cannot be built, benchmarked, and operated by the architect who proposed it, it is not ready to become a standard.
The role bridges the Principal Data Architects enterprise direction and the Staff Data Engineers delivery execution. It requires deep GCP expertise, strong software engineering discipline (test-driven development, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code), and the ability to influence without direct authority. The culture of the organization places an emphasis on teamwork, so social and interpersonal skills are equally important as technical capability. Due to the emerging and fast-evolving nature of GCP and AI technologies, the position requires staying well-informed of technological advancements and being proficient at putting new innovations into effective practice.
At HCA DT&I, your deliverables will influence patient care. Every process, technology, and decision matters.
Major Responsibilities:
Core Competencies
The following are highlighted entrepreneurial competencies and core expectations for the job/role:

  • Architectural judgment grounded in hands-on implementation
  • Deep technical expertise in cloud data platforms
  • Strong problem-solving, systems design, and software engineering skills
  • Ability to bridge business, clinical, and technical domains
  • Communication and interpersonal skills; influence without authority
  • Understand strategic imperatives

Hands-On Architecture & Reference Implementation

  • Design data architecture patterns for a defined platform or domain within the GCP Lakehouse ecosystem, and personally build the reference implementations that prove them.
  • Write production-quality code (Python, SQL, Java/Scala) for ingestion frameworks, transformation pipelines, and platform tooling not prototypes thrown over the wall, but modular, tested, reusable code that serves as the pattern others follow.
  • Benchmark and validate architectural options empirically: build competing approaches, measure cost, throughput, and latency, and let evidence drive the standard.
  • Spend meaningful time in the codebase alongside engineers pairing, reviewing pull requests, and debugging production issues to keep designs anchored in operational reality.
  • Produce architecture decision records (ADRs), reference architectures, and diagrams that are backed by working artifacts in source control.
  • Modernize and refactor legacy pipelines, leading migrations through direct contribution rather than delegation alone.

Lakehouse & Data Platform Design

  • Design and build Lakehouse environments using BigQuery, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, and GCS, including schema evolution, ACID compliance, partitioning, clustering, metadata management, and lifecycle policies.
  • Model data and access patterns that serve both analytical and AI-driven workloads; implement the initial models and validate them against real query workloads.
  • Optimize storage and compute for cost and performance across large-scale document and data repositories; instrument pipelines so cost and performance are observable, not estimated.
  • Define and uphold SLAs for timely delivery of data, and build the monitoring that proves they are met.

Ingestion, Processing & AI Enablement

  • Design, build, and tune ETL/ELT and real-time ingestion pipelines using Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Kafka, Spark Streaming, Cloud Run, Cloud Composer, GKE, and Cloud Functions.
  • Build multi-modal ingestion capabilities handling structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data (documents, text, images, PDFs, audio/video metadata).
  • Implement AI-assisted ingestion patterns semantic chunking, embedding generation, metadata extraction, classification, and enrichment in partnership with the AI/ML practice, and integrate them into pipelines hands-on.
  • Partner with AI/ML teams on vector storage and retrieval (RAG) patterns aligned with enterprise governance standards.
  • Ensure ingestion frameworks are resilient, observable, idempotent, and designed for continuous evolution.

API Design & Contracts

  • Design and implement REST and event-driven APIs aligned with OpenAPI specifications, versioning standards, and backward compatibility principles.
  • Apply enterprise API governance naming conventions, authentication patterns, rate limiting, pagination, and error handling and contribute the shared libraries and templates that make compliance the default.
  • Build API layers serving both human-facing applications and AI agent consumers, ensuring consistent contract design across downstream integrations.
  • Implement secure API access patterns for PHI-sensitive and regulated data, incorporating encryption, scoping, and audit logging.
  • Review and validate API designs from vendor and internal delivery teams prior to implementation.

Engineering Practice & Quality

  • Champion test-driven development, continuous integration, and automated deployment by building them into the platforms this role delivers.
  • Implement unit and integration tests; conduct performance testing where appropriate.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (GitHub, Terraform) for data platforms.
  • Implement automated workflows that lower manual/operational costs and move the company closer to democratizing data.
  • Enable self-service data architecture supporting query exploration, dashboards, data catalog, and rich data discovery.

Governance, Security & Compliance

  • Apply and enforce best practices for data governance, security, privacy, and compliance (HIPAA, GDPR) across structured and unstructured data.
  • Ensure designs align with enterprise policies for data retention, lineage, access control, and auditability and implement the controls, not just the policy.

As a Manager – Agentic AI & Automation Lead, you will own the strategy, architecture, and delivery of GenAI and agentic automation solutions across Finance Ops and ERP AMS — and you will build and lead the team that delivers them, including AI Solution Leads and Agentic AI / Automation Engineers. You will partner with Finance and ERP SMEs to translate business pain points into AI use cases, act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, and establish the reusable frameworks that power our MS AI Factory.

  • Solution Architecture – Own end-to-end AI solution architectures for Finance Ops and ERP AMS processes, from use-case shaping through production.
  • Agentic Design – Direct the design of LLM and agentic workflows using LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Semantic Kernel — planning, tool use, memory, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • RAG & Retrieval – Govern RAG pipelines and embedding design using vector stores such as Pinecone, Chroma, or FAISS to deliver contextual, grounded intelligence.
  • Prompt & Agent Standards – Set standards for prompt chains and autonomous-agent behavior, ensuring accuracy, governance, and auditability.

ERP & Finance Integration

  • People Leadership – Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI Solution Leads and Agentic AI / Automation Engineers — setting clear goals, KPIs, and career-development plans.

MS AI Factory & Reusability

LLMOps, Governance & Responsible AI

Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory

  • Advisory – Act as a trusted advisor, presenting AI-driven insights and trade-offs to senior stakeholders in clear, non-technical language.

Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world s largest global brands do business Join us!

Youll own complex, foundational initiatives that shape the core of our platform, starting with our customer-facing control tower, where enterprises design, govern, and monitor their AI agents. Your job is to connect product strategy to coherent, elegant UX: taking ambiguous, technically deep problem spaces and turning them into experiences that feel inevitable.

  • Own end-to-end design for platform-foundation initiatives: from framing the problem and shaping strategy through to shipped, polished UX

  • Work directly with real enterprise customers, observing their challenges firsthand and designing solutions that hold up in the worlds most complex CX environments

  • Establish design patterns, systems, and quality bars that other designers and engineers build on

  • Partner deeply with Product, Engineering, and Customer teams across geographies

  • High agency: you find the problems worth solving, rally people around them, and drive them to done without waiting for permission

  • Unleashed curiosity about customers, AI, systems, and how the business works

  • Strong systems thinking: you design coherent frameworks, not one-off screens

  • Excellent collaboration and communication across cross-functional and distributed teams

  • Portfolio demonstrating craft, rigor, and measurable impact on complex products

Project Role Description : Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.

Must have skills : Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform

Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
Delivery and solution leadership role.
This role balances hands on architectural guidance with execution ownership, client leadership, and people development.

Responsibilities:

Proven experience as a Data Architect and Data Engineer leading enterprise-scale Lakehouse initiatives.
Expert-level understanding of modern Data Analytics Architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Products, and Lakehouse Architecture.
Excellent programming and debugging skills in Python.
Strong experience with PySpark for building scalable and modular ETL/ELT pipelines.
Design and build complex pipelines using Delta Lake, Auto Loader, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and deployment using Asset Bundles.
Architect data ingestion and transformation using DLT Expectations, modular Databricks Functions, and reusable pipeline components.
Must have hands-on expertise in at least one major cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Lead implementation of Unity Catalog: create catalogs, schemas, role-based access policies, lineage visibility, and data classification tagging (PII, PHI, etc.).
Guide organization-wide governance via Unity Catalog setup: workspace linkage, SSO, audit logging, external locations, and Volume access.
Enable cross-platform data access using Lakehouse Federation, querying live from externally hosted databases.
Leverage and integrate Databricks Marketplace to consume high-quality third-party data and publish internal data assets securely.
Experience with cloud-based services relevant to data engineering, data storage, data processing, data warehousing, real-time streaming, and serverless computing.
Govern and manage Delta Sharing for securely sharing datasets with external partners or across tenants.
Design and maintain PII anonymization, tokenization, and masking strategies using DBX functions and Unity Catalog policies to meet GDPR/HIPAA compliance.
Architect Power BI, Tableau, and Looker integration with Databricks for live reporting and visualization over governed datasets.
Build Databricks SQL Dashboards to enable stakeholders with real-time insights, KPI tracking, and alerts.
Hands on Experience in applying Performance optimization techniques
Lead cross-functional initiatives across data science, analytics, and platform teams to deliver secure, scalable, and value-aligned data products.
Provide thought leadership on adopting advanced features like Mosaic AI, Vector Search, Model Serving, and Databricks Marketplace publishing.
Working knowledge of DBT (Data Build Tool) is a plus.
Strong background in data modeling and data warehousing concepts is required.

7. Familiarity with DBT (Data Build Tool)

Education Qualification:
  • 15 years full time education is required.

jobDescription:
Job Title:- - - - - - - Legal Counsel - Ethics Compliance, Data Privacy

Career Level:- -Manager

Career Track:- -Corporate Function

Skill Track:- - - - -Legal

Job Summary:

The Legal Counsel - Ethics Compliance, Data Privacy is a permanent and full-time Manager role within Accenture''s Global Data Privacy team, to be filled by an experienced data privacy professional. The successful candidate will combine strong legal and privacy expertise with business acumen, and demonstrate interest and experience in AI, digital technologies and emerging technologies.

The role serves as a strategic advisor to business and corporate functions globally, helping embed privacy requirements into services, products, technology solutions and operational processes. In addition to providing privacy counsel, the successful candidate will lead and coordinate strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing the maturity, effectiveness and scalability of Accenture''s global privacy program, governance framework, operating model and privacy-by-design capabilities.



Key Responsibilities

The role has the following data privacy responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic and practical subject matter expertise to internal corporate and business functions globally on data privacy compliance, privacy risk management, privacy reviews and privacy by design.
  • Lead and coordinate strategic initiatives that further strengthen and mature Accenture''s global privacy program, including governance frameworks, operational processes, review methodologies, reporting, stakeholder engagement models and privacy-by-design capabilities.
  • Drive continuous improvement efforts to enhance efficiency, consistency, scalability and effectiveness of privacy advisory processes and related privacy program capabilities.
  • Conduct and lead Privacy by Design reviews for new and existing internal projects, services, offerings, products, technology solutions and other data privacy compliance strategic projects on a regional and global scale.
  • Partner with key business stakeholders and senior individuals to ensure privacy considerations are addressed at the outset of new services, offerings, projects, products and initiatives.
  • Conduct legal research, interpret legal and regulatory requirements, and apply a risk-based assessment of how those requirements affect new services, offerings, projects, products or initiatives.
  • Advise on privacy considerations associated with AI, analytics, automation, digital technologies and emerging technologies, balancing innovation objectives with legal, ethical and compliance requirements.
  • Build and maintain strong and trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders, in particular Legal, business teams, Corporate Functions, Data Privacy and Information Security leads, and clients as needed.
  • Work with regional and local stakeholders to create, maintain and continuously improve privacy review processes and embed privacy-by-design methodology into relevant business processes.
  • Work with other Data Privacy team roles on global Data Privacy initiatives, projects, program enhancements and cross-functional workstreams.
  • Stay abreast of legal and regulatory developments related to data privacy and adjacent fields, including AI, technology trends and developments, and translate them into guidance, training, communications and thought leadership for internal audiences.

Relationships:

Reports to: Ethics Compliance, Data Privacy Director-/p>

Key Relationships:

  • Legal, including Geographic Compliance Corporate, Employment Law, Disputes Litigation, eDiscovery, IP, Sourcing and external counsel.
  • Corporate Functions, including Global IT, Information Security, HR and other business stakeholders.
  • Market Unit leadership and senior stakeholders involved in privacy reviews, strategic initiatives and technology-enabled transformation.
  • Data Privacy and Information Security leads globally.
  • Related subject matter experts, including security professionals, records retention SMEs, analytics, AI, technology, risk management and government compliance stakeholders.


Qualification

Qualifications:

Education:

  • University law degree (Master or comparable level).
  • CIPP/CIPM or comparable privacy certification considered a plus.

Work experience:

  • Minimum 7 years'' experience in global data privacy law and practice in a global company, law firm, consulting environment or technology and IT sector.
  • Proficiency in English (both spoken and written).
  • Experience and expertise with major national data privacy legislation and cross-border privacy issues.
  • Experience advising on privacy risk management, privacy reviews, privacy by design, incident handling, individual rights requests and regulatory enquiries.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or coordinating complex cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, geographies and competing priorities.
  • Experience supporting, designing or enhancing privacy governance frameworks, operational processes, methodologies, controls or compliance program capabilities.
  • Experience advising on privacy aspects of digital transformation, AI, cloud, analytics, automation, emerging technologies or data-driven business initiatives.
  • Knowledge of Information and Communication Technologies or a technology degree or qualification.
  • Experience monitoring privacy trends and developments and translating them into actionable requirements, guidance and program enhancements.

Work Requirements:

  • Limited to no travel required.
  • Must have the ability to work effectively and independently with others remotely, manage a schedule with global clients and internal stakeholders, conduct privacy reviews and support strategic privacy program initiatives across time zones.

Knowledge and Skill Requirements

  • Strong expertise in data privacy, data security and global privacy laws.
  • Strong project, program management and operational skills in multicultural, matrixed environments.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus and translate privacy requirements into business outcomes.
  • Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills across management levels and cultures.
  • Ability to lead global teams, coordinate workstreams and deliver strategic privacy program objectives.
  • Ability to simplify complex ideas, processes and plans for legal, technical and business audiences.
  • Creative, collaborative and able to bridge differing views, requirements and risk considerations.
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented and able to identify risks, priorities and mitigation options.
  • Sound judgment in applying company policy and escalating issues timely.
  • Flexibility and resilience in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Senior Associate Agentic AI Engineer

AI Engineering & Intelligent Automation | AI Managed Services


Role Snapshot


Role

Senior Associate Agentic AI Engineer

5 to 8 years

Anywhere in India (Preferably Hyderabad / Bangalore)

Bachelors in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Masters or cloud/AI certifications preferred)

Core Skills

Agentic AI Workflows, LLM Orchestration, Python, FastAPI, AWS (Bedrock), Docker & Kubernetes, Redis/ElastiCache

Nice to Have

MCP tools, Langfuse, Evaluation harnesses, AWS certifications, Enterprise AI governance


About the Role

As a Senior Associate – Agentic AI Engineer, you will design, build, and operationalize agentic AI solutions using modern LLM orchestration frameworks and cloud-native architectures. Working alongside senior engineers, architects, and operations teams, you will deliver scalable, secure, and governed AI workflows that move reliably from development into production.

This is a hands-on, engineering-focused role covering agent design, orchestration, evaluation, and release readiness within an enterprise AI managed services environment.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic AI Workflow Development

Design multi-agent systems that coordinate reasoning, tool use, memory, and task execution using LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and similar frameworks. Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools and custom tool interfaces to extend agent capabilities.

LLM Orchestration & Prompt Engineering

Orchestrate LLM interactions with LangChain across retrieval, tools, memory, and agents. Design, test, and optimize prompts for reliability, performance, and cost — supporting versioning, experimentation, and controlled rollouts.

Backend & API Engineering

Develop Python-based AI services using FastAPI. Expose agent and workflow capabilities via secure, scalable REST APIs, with asynchronous workflows, background tasks, and event-driven processing where appropriate.


Cloud-Native AI Platform Development

Build and deploy AI services on AWS using Bedrock for foundation model access. Integrate IAM, logging, and monitoring to meet enterprise security and compliance requirements, while optimizing for performance, scalability, and cost.

Containerization & Deployment

Package services with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes. Support deployment pipelines that enable consistent builds across dev, test, and production environments in collaboration with platform and operations teams.

State, Memory & Caching

Design and implement agent memory and caching strategies using ElastiCache (Redis), optimizing retrieval, session state, and intermediate results for performance and reliability.

Observability, Guardrails & Evaluation

Implement guardrails for safety, compliance, and reliability (input validation, output constraints, tool-use controls). Instrument workflows with Langfuse for tracing and evaluation, and build evaluation harnesses to validate quality and regression risks before release.

Release, Versioning & Collaboration

Contribute to release planning by validating workflow readiness and evaluation results. Use GitHub for version control, pull requests, and code reviews, and collaborate closely with architects, product owners, and operations teams.

Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on AI Architect who can lead and build our AI/GenAI practice, with a strong focus on designing and developing domain-specific Small Language Models (SLMs) and enterprise AI solutions.

The ideal candidate will have deep practical experience across LLMs, SLMs, RAG, AI Agents, model training/fine-tuning, data engineering and cloud AI platforms. The person should be capable of taking an industry-specific business problem, determining the appropriate AI/model approach, defining the required components, building the model/solution, and taking it into production.

This role requires someone who can architect as well as engineernot just consume existing foundation models or build applications on top of APIs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead AI & GenAI Practice

  • Define and drive the organization's AI/GenAI technology strategy and practice.
  • Establish AI architecture standards, reusable frameworks, accelerators and reference architectures.
  • Identify high-value AI opportunities across different industries and customer environments.
  • Lead development of AI solutions from ideation PoC model development production deployment.
  • Build and mentor AI/ML/GenAI engineering teams.
  • Provide technical leadership for AI solutioning, proposals and customer engagements.
  • Establish best practices for AI governance, security, evaluation, responsible AI and cost optimization.

2. Domain-Specific SLM Architecture & Development

A key responsibility of this role is to design and build Small Language Models for specific industries/domains.

The candidate should be able to independently determine and define the key components required to build a domain-specific SLM, including:

  • Define the business and industry problem that the SLM needs to solve.
  • Determine whether an SLM, LLM, RAG or a combination of these is the appropriate approach.
  • Define the required model architecture and model size based on the use case.
  • Evaluate whether to:
    • Build a model from scratch
    • Adapt an existing open-source foundation model
    • Fine-tune an existing LLM/SLM
    • Use knowledge distillation
    • Use LoRA/PEFT or other parameter-efficient techniques
    • Combine an SLM with RAG and external tools
  • Define the required industry/domain-specific datasets.
  • Establish data acquisition, cleaning, normalization, deduplication and preparation processes.
  • Define data labeling and annotation requirements.
  • Establish the required tokenizer, vocabulary and domain terminology strategy where applicable.
  • Define training, validation and test datasets.
  • Select appropriate model architecture, parameters and training methodology.
  • Define training infrastructure, GPU requirements and distributed training requirements.
  • Establish model evaluation benchmarks specific to the industry/use case.
  • Define accuracy, hallucination, latency, throughput and cost targets.
  • Design model compression, quantization and optimization strategies.
  • Design inference architecture for cloud, private cloud or edge deployment.
  • Establish model monitoring, evaluation and continuous improvement mechanisms.

3. SLM Design & Engineering

The candidate should have hands-on experience with several aspects of the SLM lifecycle:

Data Model Training Fine-Tuning Evaluation Optimization Deployment Monitoring

Responsibilities include:

  • Design domain-specific datasets for model training and fine-tuning.
  • Develop data pipelines for large-scale training data preparation.
  • Select and evaluate suitable open-source/base models.
  • Fine-tune models for domain-specific terminology, reasoning and tasks.
  • Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA/QLoRA/PEFT.
  • Explore knowledge distillation from larger models into smaller models.
  • Apply quantization and model compression to reduce inference cost.
  • Optimize models for latency, memory consumption and throughput.
  • Design efficient inference architectures.
  • Build evaluation frameworks to compare models and approaches.
  • Establish automated model testing and regression evaluation.
  • Implement continuous model improvement based on production feedback.

4. LLM, RAG & Agentic AI

In addition to SLM development, the candidate should have strong hands-on experience with:

  • Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • RAG architectures
  • Embeddings and vector databases
  • Semantic and hybrid search
  • Prompt and context engineering
  • AI Agents and Agentic workflows
  • Tool/function calling
  • Multimodal AI
  • Model routing and model selection
  • LLM evaluation
  • Guardrails and hallucination mitigation

The architect should be capable of determining the optimal architecture, for example:

SLM + RAG + Enterprise Data + AI Agents + Business APIs

rather than defaulting to a large commercial LLM for every use case.

5. Industry-Specific AI Solutions

  • Work with domain experts to understand industry-specific terminology, workflows and business processes.
  • Convert industry knowledge into structured datasets, training data, knowledge bases and evaluation benchmarks.
  • Design AI solutions optimized for specific industries such as Healthcare, Financial Services, Insurance, Retail, Manufacturing, Education or Technology.
  • Develop reusable domain-specific AI components that can be adapted across customers.
  • Identify opportunities where smaller specialized models can provide better accuracy, privacy, latency and cost efficiency than general-purpose LLMs.

Key SLM Architecture Components

The candidate should be capable of defining and architecting the complete SLM ecosystem, including:

  1. Business / Industry Use Case
  2. Domain Knowledge & Taxonomy
  3. Training Data Strategy
  4. Data Collection & Data Pipeline
  5. Data Cleaning & Preparation
  6. Data Annotation / Labeling
  7. Tokenizer & Vocabulary Strategy
  8. Base Model Selection
  9. Model Architecture / Model Size
  10. Pre-training / Continued Pre-training
  11. Fine-Tuning / PEFT / LoRA / QLoRA
  12. Knowledge Distillation
  13. RAG / Knowledge Retrieval Layer
  14. Evaluation & Benchmarking Framework
  15. Safety, Guardrails & Security
  16. Model Compression / Quantization
  17. Inference Engine
  18. GPU / Compute Infrastructure
  19. Model Serving & APIs
  20. MLOps / LLMOps
  21. Monitoring & Observability
  22. Continuous Training / Model Improvement

The candidate should be able to make architectural decisions around which of these components are required for a particular use case and why, rather than applying the same architecture to every problem.

This is a high-impact role responsible for helping establish the organization's next-generation AI-native product engineering model.

jobDescription:
VP Human Resources
Company: Berkowits Hair & Skin Clinics
Function: Human Resources
Reporting To: CEO / Leadership Team
Team Size: 5 HR Professionals
Monthly Compensation: up to 1,00,000
Employment Type: Full-Time
About the Role
Berkowits Hair & Skin Clinics is looking for a young, dynamic, execution-oriented, and AI-native VP Human Resources to lead the HR function across the organization.
This is not a conventional HR leadership role focused primarily on policies and administration. We are looking for someone who is **highly data-driven, comfortable with technology, strong at execution, and capable of building scalable HR systems** for a rapidly growing multi-location organization.
The VP HR will manage a team of approximately 5 HR professionals and will be responsible for ensuring that recruitment, payroll, incentives, performance management, employee engagement, and HR operations run with high levels of accuracy and discipline.
Key Responsibilities
1. HR Leadership & Team Management
* Lead and manage the HR team of approximately 5 professionals.
* Define clear responsibilities, KRAs, and measurable targets for each HR team member.
* Conduct weekly HR reviews and ensure timely closure of pending activities.
* Build a high-accountability and execution-focused culture within the HR team.
* Identify opportunities to automate and simplify repetitive HR processes.
2. HR MIS & Analytics
Own the monthly HR dashboard and track key organizational HR metrics, including:
* Employee Headcount
* Manpower Cost
* HR Budget vs Actual
* Employee Attrition
* New Joinees
* Exits
* Open Positions
* Recruitment TAT
* Offer-to-Joining Ratio
* Employee Productivity Metrics
* Attendance and Leave Trends
* Payroll Variances
* Incentive Payouts
Present a structured Monthly HR MIS to the management team with insights, trends, and recommended actions.
3. Recruitment & Manpower Planning
* Own recruitment tracking across departments and locations.
* Ensure manpower requirements are captured and prioritized.
* Track recruitment TAT for every open position.
* Monitor recruiter performance and recruitment funnel metrics.
* Improve sourcing, screening, and interview processes.
* Build AI-assisted recruitment workflows to improve productivity and candidate quality.
* Develop talent pipelines for frequently hired positions.
4. Payroll & Incentive Processing
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing every month.
* Coordinate attendance, leave, salary revisions, deductions, and employee changes.
* Ensure payroll data is reconciled before salary processing.
* Oversee monthly employee incentive calculations and payouts.
* Create checks and controls to minimize payroll and incentive errors.
5. Performance Management
* Manage the employee performance review calendar.
* Ensure quarterly and periodic reviews are completed on time.
* Track employee KRAs, performance ratings, and review completion.
* Coordinate salary revisions, promotions, and performance improvement plans.
* Build structured performance dashboards for leadership.
6. Quarterly Corporate Reviews
* Plan and coordinate Quarterly Corporate Reviews.
* Ensure departments submit performance data and presentations on time.
* Track commitments and action items arising from reviews.
* Maintain follow-up dashboards to ensure closure.
7. Rewards & Recognition
* Own the company-wide Rewards & Recognition program.
* Create transparent criteria for employee recognition.
* Ensure regular recognition of high performers and exceptional contributions.
* Develop innovative engagement and recognition initiatives.
8. Employee Lifecycle Management
Ensure timely completion and compliance of:
* Employee documentation
* Offer Letters
* Joining formalities
* Induction
* Probation reviews
* Employee confirmations
* Transfers and promotions
* Exit interviews
* Full & Final settlement coordination
* Clearance procedures
* Experience and relieving letters
9. HR Systems & Automation
* Drive effective adoption of Keka and other HR technology platforms.
* Identify processes that can be automated using AI and workflow tools.
* Create AI-assisted systems for recruitment, employee communication, HR analytics, documentation and reporting.
* Build standardized HR SOPs and dashboards.
Key Performance Indicators
The VP HR will be evaluated primarily on:
* Recruitment TAT
* Attrition Rate
* Manpower Cost vs Budget
* Payroll Accuracy
* Incentive Processing Accuracy
* HR MIS Accuracy & Timeliness
* Employee Onboarding Completion
* Employee Offboarding Completion
* Performance Review Completion Rate
* HR Team Productivity
* Closure of HR Action Items
* Employee Query Resolution TAT
* Adoption of HR Automation & AI
Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Young, energetic, and highly execution-oriented
* Comfortable working in a fast-growing organization
* Extremely strong with numbers, dashboards, and MIS
* Comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions
* Process-driven but willing to challenge inefficient processes
* Strong at managing teams and following up relentlessly
* Excellent at Excel / Google Sheets and HR technology
* Experienced with HRMS platforms such as Keka
* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar platforms
* Curious about automation and constantly looking for ways to make HR faster and more efficient
AI-Native Mindset
For Berkowits, being AI-native*means using AI as part of everyday work rather than treating it as an occasional tool.
The successful candidate should be comfortable using AI for activities such as:
* Creating HR dashboards and reports
* Analysing attrition data
* Drafting JDs and employee communications
* Screening and summarizing candidate profiles
* Creating interview questions
* Building SOPs
* Analysing employee feedback
* Preparing management presentations
* Automating repetitive HR workflows
We are looking for someone who naturally asks:
Can technology or AI help us do this faster, better, or with fewer errors?
What Success Looks Like
Within the first 612 months, the successful candidate should have created an HR function where:
* Management has complete visibility into HR numbers.
* Recruitment positions are tracked rigorously.
* Payroll and incentives are processed accurately and on time.
* Employee onboarding and exits happen through clearly defined workflows.
* Performance reviews happen according to schedule.
* HR decisions are increasingly driven by data.
* Repetitive HR activities are progressively automated.
* The HR team operates with clear KRAs, accountability, and measurable outcomes.

  • Coordinate vulnerability identification, triage, prioritisation, remediation planning, exception management, validation, and closure.

Cloud Security

  • Manage cloud-security posture and remediation activities across AliCloud ,Azure, GCP and AWS environments.

jobDescription:
Mandatory Skills Description:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). An advanced degree is a plus but not required.

Experience: Approximately 3-5 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or a related data management role. A proven track record in designing data solutions and managing data schemas is expected.

Data Modelling & Databases: Strong proficiency in data modelling and database design. You should be comfortable creating ER diagrams and defining relational schema, as well as working with NoSQL databases (e.g. document or graph databases). Practical experience with SQL and at least one relational database is required, as well as deep knowledge of other data store types (especially graph databases) is highly needed.

Data Pipeline Development: Hands-on experience developing data pipelines and integration workflows. This includes proficiency in ETL/ELT tools or frameworks (or custom scripting with Python/SQL) to gather and transform data. You should understand how to optimise data flow and have experience with batch processing; experience with real-time streaming data (e.g. using Kafka or equivalent) is a plus.

Ontologies & Knowledge Graphs: Exposure to semantic data modelling, ontologies, or knowledge graph construction. Experience in structuring data with ontologies (e.g. using RDF/OWL standards) or implementing a knowledge graph to link datasets can be very beneficial, since it helps in creating a unified data vocabulary and enriches the context for AI models.

Cloud Data Platforms: Experience working with cloud-based data platforms or big data technologies. While our approach is cloud-agnostic, you should be familiar with concepts like data lakes, data warehouses, and distributed computing in a cloud environment (e.g. using AWS, Azure, or GCP services). The ability to design solutions that leverage cloud scalability and tools for storage and processing is important.

Data Governance & Security: Solid understanding of data governance principles and best practices. You should be knowledgeable about data privacy regulations and data protection techniques, ensuring compliance in how data is stored and used. Experience implementing data quality checks, defining data standards, and using or setting up metadata management tools will be useful.

Communication & Teamwork: Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams. You should be able to translate complex data architecture concepts into clear terms for project managers or stakeholders, and work closely with engineering teams to guide implementation. Problem-solving aptitude and a willingness to mentor junior data team members are also important in our collaborative environment.

    1. Lead the design and deployment of enterprise-scale forecasting systems with a focus on time-series modelling, performance monitoring, and long-running production systems.  
    2. Develop robust temporal data quality frameworks to handle missing data, irregular timing, and outliers directly within production pipelines.  
    3. Create and maintain forecasting systems for demand prediction, generating long-term (e.g., 24-month) forecasts using historical patterns, external factors, and advanced feature engineering.  
    4. Design interpretable ensemble approaches, combining multiple regression models with trend and seasonal decomposition to isolate key demand drivers.  
    5. Engineer reusable model training and deployment pipelines to improve consistency and reduce setup time across data science teams.  
    6. Implement rigorous performance monitoring to detect forecast issues, analyze drift, identify unusual shifts in data patterns, and prevent downstream model degradation.  
    7. Spearhead the integration and monitoring of LLM-based systems, including stability analysis and cost-forecasting modules within Azure AI and AWS Bedrock workflows.  
    8. Drive AI governance by establishing model monitoring, safety frameworks, and performance controls for secure enterprise adoption.
