    1. Experience: 6-8+ years of proven expertise in building and deploying scalable machine learning models in enterprise environments.
    2. Programming & Big Data: Advanced proficiency in Python, PySpark, SQL. Strong hands-on experience with Databricks is mandatory.  
    3. Machine Learning Core: Random Forest, Scikit-learn, K-Means/KNN, Linear Regression, and Naive Bayes.  
    4. Time Series & NLP: Strong background in temporal data exploration, pattern recognition, anomaly detection, and NLP tools (NLTK, Spacy).  
    5. MLOps & Deployment: Expertise in MLOps, LLM Ops, DevOps, Docker, Git/GitHub, and cloud deployment pipelines (AWS, Azure).

Optional/Nice-to-have Skills:

    1. MLOps: Model tracking, monitoring, CI/CD with MLflow, Kubeflow, etc.

jobDescription:
We are defining the future of the Rentals Industry
We re a profitable, growth-stage company building industry-leading martech and data products for the PropTech space. Our focus is on our category-leading AI and data SaaS products with triple-digit growth rates.
We re a fully remote team of 100+ spread across the U.S. from coast to coast. We operate on a strict no a**holes policy and are proud to have built a community of highly performant people that take our work seriously, but not ourselves. And, were looking for exceptional people to help further accelerate our growth.
While we ve raised $30MM+ to date from some of the world s best investors, we re profitable with a strong balance sheet and an indefinite runway. We pride ourselves on achieving rapid growth without having to incinerate capital.
About Our Products
ApartmentIQ is the all-in-one data platform powering smarter decisions across multifamily covering 40M units with daily property and market intelligence used for surveys, research, and revenue management. Were trusted by 65% of the NMHC Top 50. Our sister company, MavenAI , delivers AI-powered marketing automation built by industry experts and integrated directly with property management systems, serving over 2M units.

Your New Team

The ApartmentIQ team is revolutionizing how property managers optimize their operations. We provide a powerful platform that centralizes critical property data, offering actionable insights and intuitive tools to enhance efficiency and decision-making. Our product empowers users to streamline everything from leasing and maintenance to resident communication and financial reporting.
We leverage a modern tech stack, with a React/Tailwind frontend delivering a seamless user experience, backed by a robust Ruby on Rails backend. We believe in fostering an inclusive environment built on mutual trust, continuous learning, and a commitment to simplicity, where every engineer can contribute and grow.

The Role
Were hiring experienced full-stack engineers to build AI-native products across our ApartmentIQ and MavenAI pods. These are high-ownership roles: youll take features from data layer to API to interface, working closely with an experienced lead or AI engineer rather than inheriting a fully-specced ticket. If you like owning ambiguous problems end-to-end and youre excited about building product on top of LLMs and agents, not only using them to code faster this is for you.
Responsibilities
  • Own features end-to-end data model, Rails API, and front end in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  • Build product surfaces on top of LLMs and agents: ingestion, structured data, and UIs for reviewing and verifying AI-generated output.
  • Partner with a team lead or AI Engineer to take greenfield problems from ambiguous idea to shipped feature.
  • Engage with product leadership on what to prioritize and how to scope it.
Qualifications
  • 6+ years of experience as a full-stack software engineer.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails experience, including designing and building APIs.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript / ES6 and a modern front-end framework (React preferred).
  • Comfort working across the full stack, including relational databases (MySQL).
  • Experience building products utilizing agentic workflows: prompting, handling non-deterministic output, and designing for human-in-the-loop review.
  • Solid understanding of fundamental web technologies such as HTTP, REST, and JSON.
  • Ability to break down complex, ambiguous problems into digestible, shippable chunks.
  • Thrive in fast-paced startup environments and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
Bonus Skills Experience
  • Data pipeline / ingestion and processing work pulling in raw apartment rental data from XML files or APIs and transforming it into compelling content that helps renters choose their next home.
  • Experience with agentic frameworks, RAG, or LLM tool-use.
  • React ecosystem depth (Redux and similar) and strong product/UX taste.
  • Experience working with designers and AI engineers to build beautiful, intuitive front-end experiences.
  • Taste in modern trends of front-end development and a desire to build simple, user-focused UX.
Why ApartmentIQ
  • Remote-First: We offer the freedom to work from home across most of the U.S. You ll enjoy the flexibility of remote work, balanced with high-energy in-person offsites to build real connections and celebrate our wins together.
  • Competitive Compensation: We believe in hiring the best and paying accordingly. You ll receive a competitive salary that reflects your impact and expertise.
  • Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with our flexible vacation policy and dedicated paid parental leave to support you and your family s biggest milestones.
  • Total Wellness Coverage: We ve got you covered from head to toe with comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans.
  • Peace of Mind (On Us): We fully invest in your security with 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance.
  • Protection for Your Whole Crew: Access supplemental insurance for the unexpected, plus specialized coverage to keep your pets happy and healthy, too.
  • Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial goals with our 401k Program, helping you build for the long term while you help us build the company
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process, please contact your recruiter.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Research

About the role

Were looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the SIW Platform team. Operating under the larger Enterprise Access pillar, the SIW Platform team owns Oktas secure web experiences for end-user authentication and access. We build the Okta Sign-In Widget (SIW) a highly secure, open-source login platform designed to be easily customized and extended both by our internal feature teams and by external customers.

What youll be doing

  • Manage the teams performance, goals, and career development, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment where engineers can do their best work.
  • Partner with product management and technical leads to define the strategic direction and roadmap for the team
  • Ensure the team maintains a high bar for quality, security, and operational excellence through effective processes, mentorship, and a focus on testing and automation.
  • Lead the team in adopting new technologies and practices, including the integration of AI into the software development lifecycle.
  • Drive key projects from inception to delivery, ensuring effective cross-functional collaboration and clear communication with stakeholders.
  • Recruit, hire, and retain top engineering talent, building a diverse and high-performing team for the long term.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers, including performance management and career growth planning.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technical projects from planning to execution, with a strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and CI/CD.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  • Strategic mindset with experience contributing to product and technical roadmaps.

Technical Qualifications:

  • A strong technical background in building scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.
  • Familiarity with modern frontend stacks, including JavaScript/TypeScript, frameworks like React, and tooling such as Webpack or Vite.
  • Familiarity with server-side software architecture and frameworks including Java/C# and the Spring Framework.
  • Understanding of web security principles, secure coding practices, and accessibility standards (WCAG).
  • Knowledge of IAM protocols (e.g., OAuth, OIDC, SAML) and identity management concepts is a strong plus.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and secure coding practice is a strong plus
  • Prior experience as a Tech Lead or in an architecture-focused role is highly desirable.

Education and Training:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of software development experience, with at least 5 years of experience designing and building enterprise grade software
  • 2+ years managing engineering teams, balancing new feature/product development and maintaining existing features.
